articleTitle: Optimization Dispatch Modeling for Demand Response Considering Supply and Demand balance and Security Constraints
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to cope with the problem of photovoltaic and wind power consumption, demand response resource is introduced in the power spot market, and the effect of the demand side in the power spot market is increased through price signals and incentive mechanisms. The demand response resources maintain a balance between power supply and demand through participating in the real-time dispatch of the power grid through the power spot market. However, changes of renewable energy output and load have caused the grid power flow and node voltage to face the risk of exceeding the limit, so network security constraints have become a key factor restricting the consumption of renewable energy. First, analyze the relationship between supply and demand bidding costs and interactive response volume based on the power spot market. Secondly, considering network security constraints and supply and demand constraints, with the goal of minimizing the total power purchase cost on the grid side, a real-time optimal dispatch model is established to ensure the saftyof the operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: A CNN-LSTM Hybrid Model Based Short-term Power Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Power load forecasting is always one of the most important research focuses in power systems, which can assist power companies to optimize dispatching and reduce cost. The artificial intelligence models represented by neural network are widely used with the increasing demand of prediction accuracy. However, the potential characteristics of load series cannot be well captured based on single artificial intelligence model. To solve the problem, a CNN-LSTM hybrid model is proposed to further explore characteristics information contained in power load sequence. This model applies convolution layer of CNN to capture the features of power load data and makes power load forecasting using unique cellular structures of LSTM. This hybrid model is verified based on historical power load data acquired from Shanghai and Belgium. The prediction accuracy of CNN-LSTM outperforms other compared forecasting models after the observation of simulation results.

articleTitle: Multi Objective Low Carbon Economic Dispatch Of Power System Considering Integrated Flexible Operation Of Carbon Capture Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Carbon capture power plant is the key technology to respond to low-carbon economy and realize low-carbon development of power system. However, the static operation mode of carbon capture power plant has the coupling problem of capture and regeneration process, and its low-carbon effect needs to be further improved. In view of the above problems, this paper first deeply excavates the low-carbon and economy of the integrated flexible operation mode of carbon capture power plant, and makes a detailed modeling of the integrated flexible operation mode of carbon capture power plant; Secondly, considering the economic benefits and low carbon level of the system, a day ahead scheduling model with comprehensive cost and overall carbon emission optimization is constructed. Finally, an IEEE-39 bus system is simulated to verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheduling model.

articleTitle: A CNN Approach for Optimal Power Flow Problem for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The OPF problem for distribution networks is always a challenge in the operation or planning of power systems. The computational efficiency is crucial when solving the OPF problem. This paper develops a CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) approach, named ConvOPF, to obtain optimal power flow for the distribution network. Firstly, a CNN is constructed and trained to learn the relationship between the load and the generations. Then, the voltage magnitude and phase angle are computed directly by using an AC power flow solver. This procedure significantly guarantees the power-flow balances and reduces the number of variables that the CNN model needs to predict. Therefore, the proposed ConvOPF can reduce unnecessary iterations and improve computational efficiency significantly. The experimental results of the 33-bus power grid verify the superiority of the proposed ConvOPF approach, which computing time can speed up significantly compared to the conventional iteration-based solvers.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation and Parameter Verification of Large-scale EMT Simulation Models Based on TSP Projects
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the development of power grids, the demand for large-scale electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation is gradually increasing. However, there is still a lack of fast construction method for large-scale EMT simulation model. In this paper, an automatic generation method of large-scale EMT simulation cases using transient stability program (TSP) projects is proposed. Aiming at the numerical stability problem of the EMT model caused by some unreasonable parameters, this paper proposes a parameter conversion and verification method for EMT models. Finally, case studies were carried out in a single machine system and a real-life large-scale AC power grid system. The results show correctness of the EMT simulation case generation method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and Construction Integration Technology Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the promotion of national policies and industrial demands, the construction industry pays more and more attention to information and intelligent development, and the progress of computer technology provides technical support for the transformation and upgrading of the construction industry. This paper introduces the application of digital twin technology in the integration of architectural design and construction. Digital twin constructs a complete virtual space mapping model by using the historical operation data and sensor data update of the physical model, so as to reflect the whole life-cycle process of the physical system. In the design stage, digital twin technology can simulate the development of the whole life cycle and feedback the data to the designers to help to decide the building performance under different parameters. In the construction stage, digital twin technology can reflect the problems in the construction, reduce the construction difficulty and improve the construction quality. In the operation and maintenance stage, more variable data are collected to reflect the internal state of the building. With the support of these data, the building condition will be analyzed and diagnosed more accurately, and the maintenance is simpler and more efficient. The application of digital twin will effectively solve the problem of low degree of digitization intelligence in the current process of design and construction integration.

articleTitle: Attention-Bidirectional LSTM Based Short Term Power Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Power load forecasting plays an important role in the development of power system, which can provide crucial guidance for power supply. The short term power load forecasting can ensure the safety and stability of power grids in a short time. To solve the problem of insufficient accuracy of prediction, Attention-Bidirectional LSTM based short term power load forecasting is proposed in this paper. This model remains the basic LSTM structure, and using attention mechanism to enhance some pivotal weight. Since the multivariate influents the training differently, attention mechanism is included to strengthen the impact of key features. The simulation results show that the Attention-Bidirectional LSTM outperformers Bidirectional LSTM based on different evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Research on Voiceprint Recognition of Power Transformer Anomalies Using Gated Recurrent Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To achieve online monitoring of power transformers’ working condition and detect anomalies in time, a voiceprint recognition model based on gated recurrent unit (GRU) was proposed in this paper. Firstly, simulation experiments of a converter transformer were performed. Audio data of the transformer which worked under abnormal excitation or with a loose core were obtained. Secondly, the generation mechanism of core vibration and the spectrum characteristics of normal and abnormal audio data were discussed. Then, Mel frequency cepstral coefficient (MFCC) was used to extract features after some preprocessing. Finally, a GRU architecture was constructed, and its performance was compared with recurrent neural network (RNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) which have similar principles. The experiment results show that the spectrum characteristics of simulated audio data accord closely with the theory and the model based on MFCC and GRU can achieve effective detection of anomalies with a precision of 99.85%.

articleTitle: DC Arc Fault Risk Degree Evaluation Based on Back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The low-voltage DC power system is widely applied in solar systems, electric vehicles, large data centers, etc. DC arc fault becomes threaten to the safe operation of the DC systems. When the arc fault is in different states, the control and isolation of the fault lines or devices should be different. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes an approach to evaluate the DC arc fault risk degree under different test conditions including electrode material, air pressure, current, etc. based on back propagation (BP) neural network algorithm. Firstly, the Otsu method is used to automatically select the threshold value to binarize the arc images. The connected region is traversed to denoise the binarized images to improve the clarity of the images. Secondly, the images are transformed into Hue, Saturation and Value (HSV) space to extract the color features of the images, and the color features are sent to the classifier constructed by the BP neural network to train the features to realize the recognition of different electrode materials. The morphological features and texture features of the images are extracted. According to the effective features, the risk degree of the arc fault is divided into three levels. The effective features are sent into the classifier to train the features to evaluate the arc fault risk degree levels. The results show that the accuracy of the algorithm is more than 95% for the evaluation of arc fault risk degrees and electrode material identification. This method has a significance to evaluate arc fault risk.

articleTitle: A Sensor Fault Diagnosis Method for Gas Turbine Control System Based on EMD and SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Gas turbine control system plays an important role in the safe operation of power plants, and the sensor as the measuring device in the control system, its safety is very important, so it is of great significance to carry out the fault diagnosis research on the sensor of gas turbine control system. In order to realize the sensor fault diagnosis of gas turbine control system, A sensor fault diagnosis method for gas turbine control system based on EMD and SVM is proposed. Firstly, the sensor fault of gas turbine control system is simulated and features are extracted by using empirical mode decomposition (EMD). Then, the support vector machine (SVM) is optimized by moth-flame optimization (MFO) algorithm, and the fault diagnosis model of MFO-SVM is established. Finally, the extracted fault features are taken as the input of MFO-SVM fault diagnosis model, and the diagnosis results were obtained.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Scheduling Strategy in Residential Distribution Network Based on Multi-dimensional Network Integration
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the introduction and rapid development of the Fifth Generation (5G) wireless network, the power consumption of communication in the residential distribution network increases greatly and becomes a nonnegligible part. Additionally, as an environmentally friendly new energy, Electric Vehicles (EVs) are wildly used in the daily life of residents, and it is also schedulable with charging and discharging strategies to smoothen the daily load curve of the residential distribution network. In this paper, the communication power consumption is modeled into the static part and the dynamic part. The residential load, communication load, and EV load in the residential distribution network are considered and an integrated load model is built. Based on the multi-dimensional network integration, a two-stage day-ahead optimal power scheduling strategy of EV charging and discharging is developed, in which the first stage is aiming at minimizing the power cost of the community and the second stage is further to reduce the peak load. The simulation results of a real community in Shanghai City shows the applicability and effectiveness of the proposed model. It not only saves the power cost but also reduces the peak load and peak-valley difference and improves the comprehensive utilization of load.

articleTitle: Incipient Fault Identification in Power Distribution Systems based on Siamese Temporal Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In this paper, a method called Siamese Temporal Graph, which captures the temporal-spatial relationship between sampling points in waveform, is proposed for incipient fault detection. The procedure is explained as follows: The original waveform is re-structured into a temporal graph form and mapped by the defined Temporal Graph Convolution. An optimal mapping function is determined by minimizing the intra-class distance and maximizing the inter-class distance. Due to the transfer learning ability, this model trained with simulation data can be used to detect field data. Experiments show that it is much better than other classifiers, bringing a new insight for the incipient fault detection task in power distribution systems.

articleTitle: A Spatial-temporal Electric Vehicle Charging Load Forecasting Method Considering the Coordination among the Multiple Charging Behaviors
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) charging load forecasting is important for the planning and operation of the transportation and distribution networks. The current forecasting methods are mainly aimed at the single charging behavior at destinations or en-route fast charging stations (FCSs). But EV users have multiple charging behaviors in a day, which are continuous and interactive. Therefore, a spatial-temporal EV charging load forecasting method considering the coordination among the multiple charging behaviors is proposed. Firstly, the vehicle mobility model is proposed to obtain the spatial-temporal distribution (STD) of EVs based on the trip chain and Dijkstra algorithm. Next, the energy consumption model is proposed to calculate the State of Charge (SOC) of EVs considering the traffic condition and ambient temperature. Then, considering the multiple charging behaviors at different activity destinations and en-route FCSs, the charging load determination model is proposed to determine the EV charging load. Finally, the actual urban traffic network in Berlin, German is selected as an example to verify the method’s effectiveness. The result shows that the method proposed in this paper can analyze the impact of multiple charging behaviors’ interaction on the STD of EV charging load. The proposed method can provide the basis for the overall operation management among the multiple types of charging facilities and the collaborative guidance among the multiple charging behaviors.

articleTitle: Experimental study and application analysis of pulsed corona discharge plasma technology for odor control
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The experiment results of double dielectric barrier discharge reactor (DDBD) and pulsed corona discharge reactor (PCD) show that the optimal operating frequency of DDBD is 10kHz, the operating power is 0.5~2.1kW, but the optimal operating frequency of PCD is 1600Hz, operating power is 1~4.8kW. PCD reactor is more suitable for deodorization device because of wider operating power and operating voltage, it’s easy to control electric field intensity in appropriate value, better adapt to the working environment. The activated carbon adsorption device was set at the tail of PCD and applied in sewage pumping station, and better deodorization effect is obtained. Ozone escape is controlled in the prescribed range while filtering granular pollutants to avoid the formation of secondary pollution. Pulsed corona discharge plasma deodorization technology has the advantages of good deodorization effect, controllable ozone escape and flexible operation. With the development of power supply technology, the process cost is gradually reduced, so it has good market application value.

articleTitle: A Novel Identification Method of Power System Oscillation based on Dynamic Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Power system oscillation is a great threat to the safe and stable operation of power grid, so it is particularly important to identify the oscillation accurately. This paper presents a research on a new power system oscillation identification method based on dynamic mode decomposition (DMD). The eigenvalues and eigenvectors extracted by DMD method are used to identify the oscillation modes accurately, and the time-domain dynamic characteristics are reconstructed. A simulation example of power system oscillation is built by PSCAD and analyzed by MATLAB. The results show that the proposed method is suitable for power system oscillation pattern recognition and has good accuracy.

articleTitle: Hybrid Top-Down and Bottom-Up Approach for Residential Load Compositions and Percentages
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Load points are one of the most vital parts of power systems. Due to the new load forms and programs introduced in the demand side, the load serving entities (LSEs) no longer deal with lump loads, but rather with more dynamic, rational and price elastic loads. The high inter-temporal and behavioral variability of the load profile makes it almost impossible for utilities and system operators to expect the demand curve with the needed accuracy. A sound granularity of the load compositions and consumption percentages and patterns throughout the year is essential for avoiding energy losses, designing demand side management programs and ensuring proper adjustments of electricity rates. In this paper, a simplistic model that can be followed by system operators to initially understand the customers consumption pattern and the household load structure is proposed. A top-down approach is combined and matched with a detailed bottom-up one, to extract load compositions and percentages. Real and local load profiles integrated with household statistical data such as device time of use (ToU), number of device units per house and activities exercised in households are all included in the model. The main results of the paper show the load composition in residential demand and the percentage of such composition under seasonal-based scenarios.

articleTitle: A Fault-Line Detection Method in Non-Effective Grounding System based on Bidirectional Long-Short Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at low accuracy and difficulty in parameter setting in traditional fault line detection (FLD) methods, this paper proposes an FLD method in non-effective grounding systems based on Bidirectional Long-Short Term Memory Network (Bi-LSTM). First, when a single-phase ground fault occurs, real-time sampling data including current, power, and power factor are used as training and testing samples for the model. Then, Bi-LSTM network model is used to process time-series data to extract the deep features of the samples. Finally, an FLD model with good generalization ability is obtained. In practical applications, historical data set is used for offline training. The trained model is operated online, and the faulty line of non-effective grounding system is automatically selected. The simulation results show that the average FLD accuracy of this model reaches 88.7% without using the internal parameters of the non-effective grounding system, which has a wide range of application prospects.

articleTitle: Intelligent diagnosis and recognition method of GIS partial discharge data map based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Due to the large amount of data information in the Gas insulated switchgear (GIS) partial discharge defect sample database, if the analysis and diagnosis are directly carried out, there will be problems of slow data mining speed, poor efficiency and low accuracy. Therefore, further research is needed to apply to different types of insulation partial discharge data abnormalities of GIS equipment. The typical feature mining and fault diagnosis method of the state. First, Use the Association analysis rules and the neural network to make a data cleaning strategy to clean and normalize the sample data. Then use the self-learning algorithm evolution mechanism to train the deep neural network, update the model parameters, and continuously modify the abnormal state data of the sample library, and build the GIS equipment insulation defect partial discharge data sample knowledge base. Finally, a deep belief network partial discharge signal diagnosis neural network learning model and optimization technology based on deep learning are constructed to improve the adaptability and generalization of different types of partial discharge signal map diagnosis of GIS equipment, as well as the intelligent diagnosis speed and abnormal state information accuracy.

articleTitle: Integrating the Power Distribution Terminals into the Power Distribution Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The power distribution network is transforming to power distribution IoT (Internet of Things), which enables the overall perception of state, efficient handling of information, and convenient and feasible application of distribution network. The distribution terminals are the fundamental components and core devices of distribution network. In order to integrate the power distribution terminals into the power distribution internet of things, this paper specifies their information model, procedure of access to cloud main station, and structure of message sent to and received from cloud main station. The information model is based on IEC 61850, the access is made using UPnP (Universal Plug and Play) protocol, and the communication uses MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) protocol. These technical specifications have been verified by a power distribution IoT demonstration project in Nanjing. Therefore, these specifications act as a guide or reference for building other power distribution IoT.

articleTitle: Mechanical Faults Diagnosis of HVCB Based on Auditory Features and Sparse Representation Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The high-voltage circuit breaker(HVCB) plays an important part in power system. Detecting the mechanical faults of HVCB is of great significance to the operation of power grid. In this paper, the closing sound signals of HVCB are taken as the target signals of signal processing. In the feature extraction stage, the Gammatone Frequency Cepstrum Coefficients(GFCC) of target signals are extracted according to the response characteristics of cochlea basement membrane. Then the linear discriminant analysis(LDA) is applied to enhance the feature representation ability of GFCC. In the feature recognition stage, the sparse representation classification algorithm is used to identify the improved GFCC due to the dimension of GFCC is too high. Finally, a 110kV HVCB is taken as the experimental object to implement field experiments. The jamming and refusing to operate faults of HVCB are set artificially. And the experimental results show that the recognition method proposed in this paper can complete the mechanical faults diagnosis of HVCB well.

articleTitle: Application of digital twin in operation and maintenance of power transmission project
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The power transmission projects are one of the important parts of the power grid. However, due to large amount of complex work quantity and harsh natural environment of the located area of some transmission lines, the operation and maintenance work of the power transmission projects are difficult and rely heavily on professional experience. Therefore, in order to improve the efficiency and save manpower and financial resources, this paper applied the digital twin (DT) technology on the operation and maintenance of power transmission projects. With the assistance of DT technology, virtual power transmission projects model in the digital world could be analyzed to infer faults that will occur in the real world. In this case, operation risk could be prevented and potential failure could be remedied in advance. It only needs to monitor the state of virtual body remotely, no longer need to monitor the entity frequently, and locate the fault location accurately, and does not need to carry out the overall repair. The DT technology made the operation and maintenance work in power transmission projects more efficient.

articleTitle: Robot path planning based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: It is easy to arise problems such as early search time is long, get stuck at local optimum easily and convergence speed is slow when traditional ant colony algorithm is uesed to path planning, Therefore, this paper put forwards an improved ant colony algorithm. According to the evaluation function of A* algorithm, the heuristic function is optimized, and the weight coefficient is adjusted dynamically and thus raise the efficiency of search path through algorithm, which is conducive to global optimization. The grid method is applied to create obstacle environment for simulation. The experimental results indicate that the improved algorithm can plan a shorter path and the convergence speed is significantly faster.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Assessment of Large-scale AC/DC Hybrid Power Grid Based on Separation Feature and Deep Belief Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Transient stability greatly challenges the safe and stable operation of the power system. Therefore, it is extremely necessary to assessment transient stability quickly and accurately. This paper proposes an intelligent model for transient stability assessment (TSA) based on the separation feature and deep belief networks (DBN) for large-scale AC/DC hybrid power grid. With this model, a training method which is suitable for large-scale AC/DC hybrid power grids was proposed. According to the correlation degrees between different electrical characteristics and power system transient stability, the input features are separated into operation mode and disturbance mode, and then, using DBN to extract the features of the two types of input data respectively. In order to adapt the large-scale AC/DC hybrid power grid, different pre-training sample sets are applied for different DBN feature extraction networks to improve the generalization ability and reduce the complexity of model training. Test results with the proposed model on the 265-bus AC/DC hybrid power grid designed by the China Electric Power Research Institute indicated that the new model is easy to train, and it can effectively reduce the influence of imbalanced samples, with good generalization ability.

articleTitle: Simulation of Ultrasonic Wave Propagation of Partial Discharge in Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Ultrasonic method is a non-invasive partial discharge (PD) detection method for power equipment, which plays a more and more important role in partial discharge location. The propagation characteristics of ultrasonic in converter transformer can be effectively analyzed by using numerical method. In this paper, according to the actual size of a 110kV converter transformer, the 3-D finite element simulation model of converter transformer is established to simulate the propagation of ultrasonic signals in the tank. A 2-D model is then established to simulate the influence of windings on the propagation of ultrasonic signals. The simulation results show that when the partial discharge is generated, it will spread around in the form of a spherical wave, which spreads over the entire converter transformer space within 2000μs. The sound pressure amplitude is exponentially decreased with the increase of distance between PD sources and prbes, and the drastic attenuation is caused by the windings and core. When the discharge source is located between the winding and the core or between the windings, the wave arrival time from the partial discharge source to the ultrasonic sensor will be increased. The analysis can provide the basis for the detection and localization of partial discharge in converter transformer.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Power Quality Disturbance Tolerance and Performance of SSTS
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Solid State Transfer Switch (SSTS) can improve the reliability of power supply and mitigate the impact of voltage sags and short-time interruptions by fast and automatic switching of dual or multi-channel power supply. Considering the lack of experimental study on the tolerance characteristics of transient/steady-state power quality of SSTS at home and abroad, the structure and working principle of SSTS is firstly analyzed. Under the condition of only known nameplate parameters such as rated voltage and power of the SSTS selected from a manufacturer, the switching ability and tolerance characteristics of SSTS to different power quality disturbances are tested, and the switching thresholds and switching logic of SSTS for transient and steady-state disturbances are analyzed and summarized.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent diagnosis and recognition technology of GIS partial discharge data atlas based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: GIS plays an important role in power system,so when there is a failure in GIS,it will affect the stable operation of the whole power system, and even threaten the security issues,partial discharge is a common fault in GIS, and it can be caused by many reasons.The insulation fault can be predicted in advance by live detection or on-line monitoring of partial discharge. However, due to the low efficiency of the current equipment condition based maintenance, there is a lack of effective intelligent diagnosis algorithm. In view of this situation, an intelligent diagnosis and recognition technology of GIS partial discharge data atlas based on deep learning is proposed. Firstly, on the basis of deep learning neural network and data fusion theory, combined with the application of AI Artificial Intelligence Algorithm in UHF and ultrasonic partial discharge defect diagnosis of GIS equipment, the intelligent diagnosis model of UHF and ultrasonic partial discharge data Atlas of GIS equipment based on deep learning is constructed, and then the intelligent diagnosis and analysis system of GIS partial discharge data based on artificial intelligence is developed, Finally, the intelligent diagnosis and recognition of partial discharge data Atlas of GIS equipment are realized. The experimental results show that the data intelligent analysis system has excellent data classification and judgment performance in the face of multimodal data. In general, deep learning greatly improves its computational efficiency by using neural network pre training algorithm. In addition, its high efficiency in data fitting and classification makes it show great industrial application potential and commercial application value in the social production and life with the rapid development of information technology and the continuous expansion of data scale and complexity.

articleTitle: A Fast Converged Voltage Control Method based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Keeping the voltage level in desired range is of great importance to power grid’s stability. Thus, the voltage control is one of the most important task in daily power grid’s operation. However, with the integration of distributed energy resources, demand response mechanism, and new devices, ensuring the stability of power grid becomes a challenging task. The traditional secure and economic operation, which is defined off-line, should be re-determined. In this article we propose a deep reinforcement learning based fast converged autonomous voltage control method, along with well-defined training paradigm and fine-tuned hyper parameter. A IEEE 14-bus case is used for testing the applicability and performance of the method. The result shows that our method has enough capability of controlling the voltage level in power grid with high convergence speed.

articleTitle: Price Prediction and Benefit Analysis on PV Power Generation Projects in the Carbon Trading Market
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Under the grid parity policy, the development of photovoltaic power generation projects is facing economic problems. Participating in the carbon trading market can not only reduce carbon emissions, but also help photovoltaic power generation projects obtain more benefit. In order to study the impact of the carbon trading market on photovoltaic power generation projects under the grid parity policy, two perspectives can be proceeded, namely the benefit perspective and the cost perspective. In the study of the carbon trading market, an improved Long Short-Term memory model is used to minimize the impact of the randomness of carbon trading price on photovoltaic power generation projects. The results show that, improved Long Short-Term memory model greatly reduce prediction errors; no matter from the perspective of benefit or cost, the carbon trading market can help the development of photovoltaic power generation projects under the grid parity policy.

articleTitle: Summary of research on superconducting synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Since the discovery of high-temperature superconducting materials in the 1990s, high-temperature superconducting motors have gradually developed. Since the 21st century, high-temperature superconducting motor technology has developed rapidly, and a series of results have been achieved. This article describes in detail the development history of high-temperature superconducting motors in recent years, and introduces the principles of high-temperature superconducting. The structure diagram is shown. Finally, the advantages of the high-temperature superconducting motor are summarized, and its application prospects are analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Voiceprint Recognition of Electrical Faults With Lower False Alarm Rate
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To reduce the false alarm rate of voiceprint recognition of electrical faults under noise interference, a two-stage algorithm was proposed in this paper. Energy storage motors of circuit breakers were taken as the research object. The sound of normal motors and motors with different kinds of abnormalities was captured. After preprocessing like framing and windowing, the Mel frequency cepstral coefficient (MFCC) were extracted as feature vectors. Then, what was different from normal was that we first fed the feature vectors into a novelty detection algorithm, one-class SVM. Only samples that were familiar to one-class support vector machine (SVM) would be delivered to the second algorithm, C-SVM. The second algorithm classified sound signals into different categories. The experiment results show that the two-stage combination can effectively reduce the false alarm rate in noisy environment and the recall rate of faults only slightly decreased when there is little noise. Specifically speaking, it reduced the false alarm rate by 63.47% when the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is –20dB and the recall of faults only dropped by 0.33% when SNR is 20dB.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of re-electrication in the transportation sector on carbon emission and pollutant emission in Yunnan province
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: China’s national promises of carbon peak and carbon neutralisation requires a zero-greenhouse gas increase consumption end, emphasising the necessity of re-electricity. Transportation sector advances in techniques, manufacture and market in electrification, enabling electric vehicles and infrastructural renewal to accelerate energy transformation and eventually helping accelerating carbon reduction goals. In this study, scenario analysis method is used to analyse the energy consumption, carbon dioxide emissions and pollutant emissions of transportation sector in Yunnan Province. The results show that carbon emission of transportation sector can reach the peak in 2029 in the deep re-electrification scenario, while it can bring the collaborative emission reduction of NOx and SO2.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis and Control Strategy Considering DC Cascading Failure Time Interval
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the production of a large number of UHVDC with the same feed and the same receiving, the probability of multiple DC failures increases greatly. In view of the complex variation of system stability margin under different DC cascading failure time interval of the terminal power grid, the oscillation energy of the dominant clustering mode at different points in the power-work Angle phase plane was extracted by CCCOI-RM. Based on the equivalent generator electromagnetic power trajectory characteristics after DC cascading failure, the most serious time interval along with the magnitude of DC cascading failure is summarized. The boundary condition of system stability margin after DC cascading locking is smaller than that after simultaneous locking is analyzed. Based on the theory, transient stability emergency control strategy considering DC cascading failure time interval is established. The conclusion is verified by real example simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Customer Service Strategy of Electricity Retail Market Based on Diffusion of Innovations Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The construction of electricity retail market poses unprecedented opportunities and challenges for the sale of electricity. The traditional mode of electricity business marketing is not suitable for the new market environment, and it needs change in many aspects. How to serve customers well in the competitive environment, seize the market, and improve their own operating efficiency is an urgent problem for power grid enterprises. This paper regards the development of electricity retail market as the diffusion process of innovation. Based on the diffusion of innovations theory, this paper analyzes the characteristics of different development stages, and formulates service strategies according to their characteristics, so as to provide reference for power grid enterprises to seize the market.

articleTitle: Application of sequential hierarchical signal method in online monitoring of partial discharge in GIS
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: After analyzing the various interferences when monitoring the Gas Insulated Substation (GIS) partial discharge, this paper puts forward a hierarchical sequential model, which can reduce the disturbance of partial discharge signal. The hierarchical sequential method, based on the Fourier series and wavelet transform method, can effectively and accurately suppress the white noise and periodic narrowband interference, so as to extract the useful partial discharge signal from the strong interference background. The method is simple, flexible and easy to apply to the other occasions. In the meanwhile, the subsequent data and simulation both verify the accuracy of the method, which will have wide range of application.

articleTitle: Reactive power sharing control strategy of multi-inverter based on weak communication
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The voltage source inverter used droop control has the characteristics of no communication, plug and play and high flexibility. Since the impedance in the line cannot be accurately measured, if multiple inverters are connected in parallel, the reactive power in parallel system cannot be accurately distributed in proportion. Therefore, a reactive power distributing control strategy of multi-inverter under weak communication conditions is proposed. First, the reactive power generated by each inverter is calculated. Then the impedance between the AC bus and each inverter is adaptively matched according to reactive power deviation. The matching algorithm will stop, when the reactive power is less than the specified threshold. Finally, the virtual impedance parameter of each inverter is adjusted to a fixed value. The proportional distribution of reactive power will no longer rely on communication. Therefore, the proportional distribution of the reactive power of multiple inverters is realized in the weak communication scenario.

articleTitle: Method for Detecting and Tracking Foreign Objects in Substation Videos Based on Embedded AI
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Foreign object monitoring is very important to maintain the safe running of substations. The development of intelligent video monitoring technology provides a solution for real-time warning and foreign object tracking in substations. Intelligent video recognition technology is gradually replacing manual monitoring. However, the current video recognition algorithms, such as moving object detection, deep learning object detection and tracking, have their own advantages and disadvantages, which cannot meet the targeted recognition of foreign objects of interest in substations or it is difficult to achieve real-time detection on embedded devices. Moving object detection is fast. YOLOv4 can locate and recognize the objects of interest with high recognition rate. And tracking algorithm has fast speed as well as good tracking continuity. Combining these three algorithms, this paper proposes a method based on YOLOv4 for foreign object monitoring and tracking in substation videos. And experiments show the method performs well in the detection and tracing of ILSVRC VID dataset and actual substation videos. It can realize front-end detection and real-time monitoring on NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX embedded development board.

articleTitle: Research on Ship-applied Low-voltage DC Smart Power Distribution Equipment with Current-limiting
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Traditional power distribution systems in ship field usually adopt power breakers, contactors, relays and fuses as power distribution devices, thus result in low fault response and lack of current-limiting, so loads with high current spikes when started may result in large voltage drop on the DC power bus or misoperation of the power distribution branch, moreover, short-circuit may bring great damage to the whole power system. In this paper, a smart power distribution equipment is proposed, to automatically distinguish different load type and state, realize current-limiting when large capacitive load is started and cut off the power distribution branch whenever short-circuit occurs. This technique greatly increases the smart management capability of the power system. The feasibility and effectiveness of this technique is verified by the experiments carried out on a 24V/2kW prototype.

articleTitle: Coordinated Recovery Method Of Multiple DC Commutation Failure Based On Stability Constraint Of Sending End System
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The voltage sag caused by DC commutation failure, especially the Multi-dc commutation failure of the same transmit ter and receiver, will affect the safe and stable operation of AC p ower network. This risk is particularly prominent for weak powe r grids. This paper focuses on the constraints of power grid frequ ency and voltage stability. It proposes a coordinated recovery me thod of Multi-DC commutation failure. A DC recovery priority i ndex DCRPI (DC Recovery Priority Index, DCRPI) is establishe d by considering effective short circuit ratio and dynamic reactiv e support capability. Firstly, evaluation the priority order of coor dinated recovery of multi-DC after commutation failure. Secondl y, the threshold of VDCOL starting voltage is optimized accordin g to the sorting result of Multi-DC coordinated recovery, which c an realize coordinated recovery after Multi-DC commutation fai lure and reduce the influence on the power of the power grid. Fin ally, the validity of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Real-time Co-simulation Design of Micro-grid and Information Communication System Based on Multi-agent System
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In future, demand response scenarios, a multitude of different types of resources are potentially to be used, e.g. electric vehicles, flexible residential loads and battery storage systems. In order to solve the problem of real-time communication of data among the various resources, it is likely to be using different communication protocols. An aggregator utilizing several types of resources is faced with a problem of semantic interoperability. This paper addresses this challenge by presenting a testbed consisting of a microgrid model integrated with several controllers communicating with industrial grade protocols for demand response, including IEC 61850, OpenChargePoint protocol (OCPP), OpenADR and UDP.

articleTitle: Adaptive Window Singular Value Decomposition Method Based on Particle Swarm Optimization for Partial Discharge Denoising
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Deterioration of insulation materials caused by partial discharge is one of the important reasons for the failure of power equipment. The noise caused by the interference of the external electromagnetic environment seriously affects the accuracy of partial discharge detection. Aiming at the problem of partial discharge noise suppression, this paper proposed a partial discharge signal noise suppression method based on adaptive window singular value decomposition. This method first randomly generated a series of windows with different positions and lengths on the noisy partial discharge signal; Then singular value decomposition method was employed to denoise the signals in each window; Finally, the denoising index was chosen as the fitness function, through the particle swarm algorithm to obtain the optimal solution of the window position and length. The noise signals obtained by simulation and experiment were verified, and the method was compared with adaptive singular value decomposition, wavelet denoising, and other methods. The results showed that this method could achieve a better denoising effect.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Typical Generator Self-starting and Research on Black Start Capability Index Evaluation System in Urban Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of black start in urban power grid, based on the layout of typical generator units in urban power grid, this paper makes a qualitative analysis on the feasibility of various typical types of generators as capable units. Based on the start-up operation data of generator units, a typical unit self start model of urban power grid based on data-driven and model driven is established, and the self start process curve is depicted. According to the operation characteristics of urban power grid units, the management level of power plants and the output capacity of generating units, an index evaluation system for black start capacity of generating units is established, and a feasible index evaluation weight value is given as a reference. Finally, the black start capability of typical generating units in Beijing power grid is evaluated, and the evaluation results can provide a reference for urban power grid multi-source black start planning.

articleTitle: Energy Saving Optimization of Internet Data Center Room Based on Computational Fluid Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Optimizing Internet Data Center (IDC) room environment is crucial to eliminate operational risks and achieve energy-saving goals. In this paper, an IDC room of a company in Shanghai is taken as the research object, and its an accurate 3D model is built by using Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulation software. The analysis of measured data and simulated data shows that there is turbulence phenomenon under the air supply floor of the IDC room and the mixed flow of hot and cold airflow in the cabinet. These two problems will reduce the heat dissipation efficiency of the equipment and increase the energy consumption of the IDC room. A feasible optimization scheme is given.

Author Keywords: Mixed flow of hot and cold air
Energy consumption of the IDC room

articleTitle: A Study on Winding MMF Harmonic and Vibration of Polyphase Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the magnetic motive force (MMF) distribution and its harmonic amplitude related to vibration of polyphase stator winding, According to a series of formulation derived, it is obvious that some MMF harmonic amplitude is much more related to stator radial force, then for different type of stator winding on the number of phases, based on the same input stator current value, it can be designed for three types of surface permanent magnet motor with different output torque density, which is also the outstanding advantage of polyphase machines compared to other type of permanent magnet (PM) motors. Then, this paper design three type motors for a 12-slot 10-pole three-phase PM motor, a 10-slot 12-pole five-phase PM motor and a 12-slot 10-pole six-phase PM motor respectively. Additionally, through the several contrast with stator inner edge core radial magnetic force, this paper analyzes its distribution wave and Fourier decomposition, develop the rule about how the MMF harmonic and magnetic density in air gap effect the radial force and cause the deformation of stator core and housing, and how to avoid this type vibration by weakening the MMF harmonic amplitude on related order and improve the magnetic density wave in other ways.

articleTitle: Optimization of Energy Sub Hub with Wind Power and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Under the dual pressure of the growing crisis in energy and severe pollution in environment, the research on energy utilization has attracted people’s attention. Energy hub (EH) is a dual port network node which can represent the complex coupling among different types of energy. In this paper, a new energy hub model is applied with the Monte Carlo method in order to reduce the impact of uncertainties of the wind power. Considering the constraints of energy storage and demand response, an optimal scheduling model of the minimum energy daily payment is established. Simulation results in different scenarios validate the feasibility and generality of the sub hub model. Besides, the results indicate that the participation of energy storage systems (ESSs) and demand response programs (DRPs) has a certain effect on reducing costs.

articleTitle: Smart energy management model for households considering incentive-based demand response
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Residents with advanced measuring and controlling appliances can participate in demand response (DR) by the home energy management system (HEMS), thereby improving the reliability and flexibility of the power system. However, the domestic incentive mechanism is deficient, and there is short of home energy optimization model that comprehensively considers price-based and incentive-based DR. First at all, a variety of flexible appliances such as distributed photovoltaic (PV), electric vehicle (EV), and energy storage (ES) were considered, a mixed-integer load model under a complex power consumption environment was classified and established. Secondly, the price-based DR based on the time-of-use electricity price and the incentive-based DR based on the user agreement were considered comprehensively. Taking reducing household electricity costs and household net load power fluctuations as joint optimization targets, a day-ahead scheduling model considering users' willingness to participate in incentive-based DR was established. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model was verified based on the MATLAB.

articleTitle: Research on Cable High Frequency Passive Equivalent Circuit Model Based on Vector Fitting
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The modeling method of the cable mainly has physical law and black box method, in order to avoid the impact of factors such as external environmental factors and internal skin effects in physical method, this paper is based on vector fitting algorithm, using black boxes method Modeling the cable. Only the relationship between the input and output of the cable is considered, and the high-frequency passive equivalent circuit model of the cable is studied. First, this paper takes the 10kV high voltage cable produced by a company as the experimental object, and the impedance of the cable is measured at a frequency range of 1 MHz-10 MHz; Secondly, the impedance amplitude spectrum and impedance phase spectrum of the cable at high frequency are fitted by using the vector fitting algorithm and the circuit synthesis theory, and the high frequency circuit model of the cable is obtained; Then, the pattern search algorithm is used to optimize the model passively, and then a stable high frequency passive circuit model is obtained. Finally, MATLAB/Simulink simulation is used to verify the correctness of the above model. This model has a certain guiding role for the study of high-frequency signals in cable and the construction of cable model under the condition of high-frequency.

articleTitle: Feedback Linearization Control for MMC Considering Capacitor Voltage Harmonics
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: As a typical nonlinear system, the modular multilevel converter (MMC) contains highly coupled states. The conventional feedback-error-based control scheme is designed on the basis of classical linear system control theory, which may be inadequate regarding the dynamic performance. Feedback linearization control (FBLC) has been studied to improve the control effect. However, the existed MMC nonlinear model for FBLC neglects the impacts of the capacitor voltage harmonics in MMC submodules. This paper derives the FBLC law by considering the capacitor voltage harmonics in MMC nonlinear model. The detailed calculation process for constructing the control law is presented. Simulation results verify the effectiveness and necessity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Basic Errors of High-level Electric Energy Meter Verification Device
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The high-level electric energy meter verification device(EEMVD) is a kind of verification device used to verify standard electric energy meters. The basic error is the fundamental indicator of the metrological characteristics of the EEMVD. This article compares and analyzes the basic errors of three sets of high-level EEMVDs used in the electric energy measurement laboratory. The verification data show that the domestically developed verification device fully meets the accuracy requirements of the verification regulations, and the accuracy level is equivalent to the level of ZERA company's high-level EEMVD.

articleTitle: Influence of wind thermal power capacity ratio on transient stability of AC / DC transmission system
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The hybrid transmission method of wind-thermal-bundled via AC and DC power transmission not only increases the capacity of external transmission but also enhances the flexibility and control of long-distance power transmission, which fully reflects the respective advantages of AC and DC power transmission systems. Due to the volatility and unique control methods of wind power, the integration of large-scale wind power into the AC/DC hybrid transmission system will adversely affect the transient stability of the system. In order to ensure the transient stability of the hybrid transmission system after the integration of wind power, it is necessary to conduct in-depth research on the ratio of wind and heat capacity. The model and theoretical derivation of the hybrid system of wind-thermal-bundled via AC/DC delivery established in this paper qualitatively summarizes the influence of wind power connection on system transient stability, and uses software of PSAT to build a system model for simulation experiments. The results verify the rationality of the summarized rules, and lay a foundation for using the wind-thermal-bundled capacity ratio to improve the system damping ratio and weaken the influence of wind power integration on the transient stability of the hybrid system.

articleTitle: Strategy of Orderly Power Utilization Based on Heavy Haul Lines in a Province
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: DSM(Demand side management) is one of the main strategies that have been widely applied for solving short-term power shortage. Among them, orderly power utilization is the most important means of regulation. In this paper, an orderly power consumption regulation strategy is constructed with the goal of maximizing the user's income and minimizing the power loss of the grid company. By studying the power consumption of heavy lines in a province, this paper lays a foundation for formulating the regulation strategy of orderly power consumption. The effectiveness and feasibility of the strategy are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Liquid Leakage Detection Of Power Plant Pipelines Based On Improved Vibe Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Liquid leakage in power plant pipelines not only wastes resources, but also affects the safe and stable production requirements of power plants. In order to detect the liquid leakage area of power plant pipelines timely and accurately, and meet the requirements of practical application, this paper proposes a method of power plant pipeline liquid leakage detection based on improved ViBe algorithm. According to the characteristics of power plant pipeline liquid leakage, and the traditional ViBe algorithm cannot adapt to dynamic background changes and quickly eliminate ghosting problems in the detection results, this paper chooses to expand the sampling neighborhood of the background model and adopts an adaptive radius threshold determined by the dispersion coefficient. To improve the accuracy of leak detection, and re-determine the leaking and non-leaking areas through Otsu threshold calculation, quickly and effectively suppress the appearance of ghost areas, so as to make the segmented power plant pipeline liquid leakage area more complete.

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of fuel and electric car on urban thermal pollution with electric energy substitution
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to analyze the environmental protection significance of electric energy substitution in transportation field, the calculation formula of energy consumption efficiency of fuel cars and electric cars are established; to analyzes the influencing factors of automobile performance with parameter investigation and to estimates the effective energy consumption efficiency. The concept of automobile thermal pollution was put forward based on the quantitative analysis of energy consumption efficiency, then the calculation results show that the thermal pollution emission ratio of fuel cars accounts for 81% of the total energy consumption of cars, while electric cars only account for 19%; compared with fuel cars the thermal pollution emission of electric cars is reduced by 18 times under the same energy demand. The average daily warming value from thermal pollution emission of cars in five typical cities is calculated. The results show that: the promotion of electric cars is conducive to alleviate the urban climate warming and heat island problems, and strongly support the realization of "double carbon" goal.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Cascaded Hydroelectric Plants Based on Primal-dual Interior Point Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The optimal scheduling of cascaded hydroelectric plants is a large-scale nonlinear non-convex optimization problem with multi-period, multivariable, and multi-constraints. Its solving process is very complicated. The primal-dual interior point method has good convergence and can reflect the original problem's nonlinear factors when solving multivariable nonlinear problems. In this paper, the primal-dual interior point algorithm is developed to solve stochastic programming's expected value model considering natural inflow uncertainty. The simulation results of cascaded hydroelectric plants show that the method can solve the optimal dispatching problem. It will provide strong support for hydroelectric plants' scheduling plans and rapid decision-making, which possesses good engineering application prospects.

articleTitle: Ultra-short-term wind energy prediction based on wavelet denoising and multivariate LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Wind energy is a typical representative of environmentally friendly new energy. However, its huge randomness and suddenness have caused many harms and losses to the actual applied wind power. Therefore, predicting wind energy in advance and improving the prediction accuracy have become the top priority. Since the wind energy data is a kind of time series, LSTM model has excellent performance. Most researches are focused on one-dimensional wind energy data. This paper uses a multivariate LSTM model. In addition to weather conditions, the wind energy at the previous moment is included as one of the variables to establish a prediction model. The model built including the wind power at the last moment performed very well. This paper compares it with the prediction model that does not consider the wind power at the previous moment, and verifies its effectiveness.The innovation of this paper is that firstly, wavelet denoising, a signal processing method, is applied to wind energy data processing, and secondly, a multivariate LSTM model is used to forecast wind energy. Considering that wind energy is a time series, the wind energy at the previous moment is also introduced except wind speed and wind direction. Compared with the prediction model that does not include the wind energy at the previous moment, the accuracy is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Power Distribution Control Strategy of Energy Storage Unified Power Quality Controller with Fixed Power Angle
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The conventional unified power quality controller (UPQC) control strategy based on power angle control enables series converters to share the burden of shunt converters, but when the power supply voltage has both amplitude and phase changes, The phase of the load will have a sudden change, which will affect the phase-sensitive load. Therefore, this article proposes a constant power angle control of the energy storage type UPQC control strategy. Based on the realization of the coordinated distribution of the power of series and shunt converters, the phase of the load voltage is not affected by the phase jump of the power supply voltage within a certain range. The capacity configuration of the series and shunt converters can realize the function of uninterruptible power supply. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy can achieve the above functions.

articleTitle: Synchronization of islanded microgrid cluster based on virtual oscillator control
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: A synchronization control strategy for islanded microgrid clusters is proposed aiming at the problem of stable operation of multi-interconnected microgrids under the condition of no communication or a small amount of communication. Based on the synchronization mechanism of coupling oscillators in the complex network, the microgrids can be controlled to emulate the dynamics of nonlinear dead-zone oscillators and achieve stable networked synchronization without the restriction of communication conditions of the microgrid cluster. Inside every sub-microgrid, the control strategy based on the point of common coupling (PCC) voltage filtering tracking error is adopted to realize the grid-forming operation of multi-parallel distributed generations (DGs) so as to ensure the rapid and accurate control of the PCC voltage and frequency. The effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified based on the Matlab /Simulink simulation platform.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Hydropower Stations based on Chance-Constrained Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the optimal dispatching problem of hydropower stations considering the uncertainty of natural inflow, an optimal dispatching model of hydropower stations based on chance-constrained programming is proposed. The uncertainty of natural inflow is an important factor affecting the optimal operation of hydropower stations. In this paper, the prediction error of natural inflow is taken as the uncertainty, and the randomness of natural inflow is described by the probability distribution of uncertain quantity. The chance-constrained programming theory is introduced into the optimal operation of hydropower stations, and the chance-constrained problem is transformed into a deterministic problem to solve. Finally, the results of numerical examples show that the proposed method is feasible and can effectively balance the robustness and economy of the system by controlling the risk coefficient.

articleTitle: Operation Boundary Analysis of Multi-energy Complementary Systems Considering the Uncertainties of Distributed Generations
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The randomness and uncertainties of distributed generations (DGs) increase the probability of voltage violation and power flow violation. It requires some adjustment and control measures to avoid out-of-limit situations. Hence, to improve the operational security and reliability of the multi-energy complementary systems with DGs, it is necessary to conduct operation boundary analysis in the operational planning of multi-energy complementary systems. In this paper, the zonotope-based uncertainty analysis method is used to analyze and calculate the operation boundary of the multi-energy complementary systems, and the influence of DG uncertainties on the steady-state characteristics of the multi-energy complementary systems is also studied. The prospects of the proposed method are carried out by the simulation studies of a 59-node distribution network system with CCHP (Combined Cooling Heating and Power) unit. Simulation results show that the proposed method can describe the correlation between voltage magnitudes of any two different nodes. Thus, the influence of DG output on the node voltages could be analyzed under different uncertainty levels.

articleTitle: An investigation on deformation behavior of Lithium-ion battery based on the electrochemical-thermal-mechanical coupling model
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To find out a more effective way to detect the overcharge of Lithium-ion battery (LIB), using the LIB module, heat transfer module and mechanics module, the electrochemical-thermal-mechanical coupling model of LIB is constructed in the COMSOL Multiphysics. The temperature and deformation of LIB under different state of charge (SOC) including overcharge are studied using the coupling model. The simulation results show that when the LIB is overcharged, the deformation of the battery shell will increase accompanied with a large temperature increase. In addition, the temperature and deformation of the overcharged LIB under different charge currents and ambient temperature are studied using the coupling model, and the results show that both the charge current and the ambient temperature have some effect on the overcharged battery. With the increase of the charge current and ambient temperature, the deformation of the battery shell will increase and the rate of battery temperature rise will be larger.

articleTitle: The real-time control strategy of double layer and double time scale for combined frequency regulation of thermal power energy storage
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the large-scale introduction of renewable energy, it has a great impact on the stability of the power system, and the energy storage system assists the thermal power unit to participate in frequency modulation, which can effectively smooth the frequency fluctuation of the system.In order to better improve the ability of energy storage to assist the frequency modulation of thermal power generators, this paper proposes a dual-layer dual time scale real-time control strategy for a combined thermal power-energy storage system. In the upper layer, the rolling optimization model is established based on the model predictive control method, and combined with the ultra short term prediction results, the rolling optimization is carried out by considering the tracking deviation; i The lower-level real-time control strategy considers the state of charge of the BESS, and coordinates the real-time power of the unit and the BESS to further reduce the influence of frequency fluctuations on the system. Finally, the proposed control strategy is verified through the analysis of a calculation example. The results show that the strategy not only achieves a good control effect, but also stabilizes the SOC of BESS in an ideal range, and has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Power Grid Parameters Determining Based on Extended Sensitivity Matrix in Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of the electric power reform, regional power grids have gradually developed into an interconnected form with high complexities. To reduce the complexity of the large-scale power grid and simplify the analysis and calculation, an equivalent network with simplified critical information that can effectively simulate the original grid is required in the operation of electricity market. To this end, this paper proposes a method for extracting the critical parameters of large-scale power grid based on an improved power transmission distribution factor (PTDF) matrix. The developed improved PTDF matrix is easy to be calculated and can be directly used as the network parameter of the equivalent model. In the case study, the proposed method is first illustrated on the IEEE 14-nodes test system. Then, the proposed method is leveraged to extract the critical parameters for Shanghai Power Grid based on the field BPA data. Four metrics including the locational marginal price (LMP), active power outputs of generators, reserved node voltage phase angles, and the power flow of reserved lines are testified on both the equivalent networked and original network. The results demonstrate that the proposed improved PTDF matrix-based parameters extraction method can well reflect the operating conditions of the system under normal conditions while also applicable for congestions.

articleTitle: Frequency Domain Modeling and Analysis of DFIG Considering Power Control Loop
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The broad frequency band oscillation accident of the power system caused by the integration of wind power generation seriously threatens the safety and stability of the power system. Frequency domain modeling and analysis is an important method to study system stability. In order to simplify the system complexity, the derivation of the doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) admittance model generally only considering the impact of the current control loop. But when the voltage disturbance occurs at the point of common coupling (PCC), the power control loop will inevitably introduce the power fluctuation into the current control loop, which will affect the admittance characteristics. This paper derives DFIG admittance models under the dq axis that consider both the current control loop and the power control loop of the rotor side converter (RSC). Moreover, comparative analysis of three types of admittance model is carried out, which is based on actual parameters. The results show that it is necessary to consider the controller in modeling and analysis, and the power control loop has a great influence on the DFIG admittance matrix.

articleTitle: Resonance analysis and suppression for multiparallel inverter system of V2G
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The action of various electric vehicles’ disordered discharging will bring great interference to the stability of grid and the daily load forecasting and power scheduling will suffer adverse impact. In V2G mode, the LCL-type grid-connected power converter serving as the rectifier and inverter is commonly used. Voltage source grid-connected inverters (GCIs) with LCL-filter have been extensively applied by the V2G control. However, it is a high-order system that has serious resonance issues at the resonance frequency. The complex impedance network of the charging piles causes parallel and series resonance problems between inverters and the utility grid, making the resonance problems more complicated, sometimes the oscillation even pushes the grid system to enter the unstable state, which restricts the large-scale application of EVs. This paper proposed an adaptive virtual impedance reshaping method (AVIRM) to solve the harmonic resonance problems in the multi-parallel inverter system (MIS) by implementing the on-line grid impedance detection. Parameters of Quasi-Proportional-Resonance (QPR) controller and AVIRM control loop are changed in real time, which ensures the stability of the system with the grid impedance variations. The proposed method improves parameter regulation efficiency in VIRM. Finally, results validate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Novel UPQC based on variable impedance
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: A unified power quality controller based on a magnetic flux control tunable reactor is proposed. The magnetic flux control tunable reactor is composed of a voltage source inverter (VSI) and a transformer with an air gap. The power quality controller is divided into two parts: the harmonic open circuit part is connected in series in the system, and the harmonic short circuit part is connected in parallel in the system. Among them, the series part detects the fundamental wave component of the primary side current of the transformer, generates a reference signal, and controls the VSI to generate a fundamental wave controllable current, after the filter is applied to the secondary side of the transformer, the primary side of the transformer will show variable impedance and open circuit to the fundamental wave and harmonic current respectively; The parallel part detects the fundamental wave component of the primary side current, generates a reference signal, and controls the VSI to generate a fundamental controllable voltage, After the filter is applied to the secondary side of the transformer, the primary side of the transformer presents controllable impedance and short circuit to the fundamental wave and harmonic current respectively.By building a MATLAB simulation model, the effectiveness of the proposed unified power quality controller is verified.

articleTitle: Simplified Model of Distributed PV Generation and Influence Analysis on Load Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With a large number of distributed PV generation (DPVG) integrated into the distribution network, the equipment composition in the load region changes significantly as well as the overall dynamic characteristics of the load region. Therefore, the DPVG must be considered in load modeling. The detailed model of the PV generation system is complex and has many parameters, which is not easy to be combined into the existing composite load model. Therefore, a simplified DPVG model is proposed which uses the controlled current source to represent the DPVG system and only retains the active power control loop.
