The number of the model parameters is reduced to three including the two coefficients of a PI controller and an equivalent impedance of distribution lines. The simulation shows that with high DPVG penetration, the active power fluctuation of the entire load region increases significantly under voltage sag comparing to the pure load of the same power, while the reactive power fluctuation decreases after the fault is cleared. Therefore, it is not appropriate to directly subtract the DPVG power from the load power when modeling the load region with a high proportion of DPVG. A separate DPVG model must be combined into the model of the load region with a high DPVG proportion.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment for Renewable Energy Penetrated Power Systems Considering Battery and Hydrogen Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Energy storages can significantly relieve the pressure of the power system brought by a large amount of renewable energy generation. Under this situation, the risk assessment method becomes critical. In this paper, an explicit model for diverse energy storages with battery and Hydrogen Storage Systems (HSS) is built. Further, an optimal load shedding model by utilizing the sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) method is proposed to assess the risk of the power system with diverse energy storages. Then, the proposed method is test on a power system which is adapted from the IEEE 24-bus system. The numerical results show that diverse energy storages can improve risk assessment results of the power system.

articleTitle: Dynamic Resistance Measurement Based on the Whole Lifetime of Breaker Arcing Contact
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The electrical lifetime of high-voltage SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> circuit breaker is determined by the condition of the contacts. In this paper, the electrical erosion tests have been conducted on two 40.5kV and 126kV circuit breakers to obtain the dynamic resistance curve for contacts in different erosion levels and with different DC test current. The experimental results show that: a) the normal values of main and arcing contact resistance are 50-150μΩ and 200-400μΩ; b) the contact travel of arcing contact decreases linearly with the number of erosion tests; c) the DRM with higher testing current gives more accurate result. The DRM with DC testing current higher than 1kA gives a more accurate result. The contact travel of arcing contact has an important influence on the performance of arc extinguishing chamber and the contact travel of arcing contact has been proved to be the determinant influencing factor for the electrical lifetime of the circuit breaker. Finally, diagnostic method of circuit breaker electrical lifetime has been put forward based on the parameters of contact resistance and contact travel.

articleTitle: Decoupling State Estimation for Microgrid Park of Integrated Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In addition to the power network, the integrated energy system also includes other energy networks, such as heating and cooling networks, combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) units, electric boilers, heating pumps and other coupling equipment with different properties. The traditional estimation method of power networks ignores the information from heating/cooling networks. To take into account the interconnections between the networks, this paper focuses on integrated energy system modeling and state estimation (SE) algorithm, and studies the relevant SE theories. To improve the estimation accuracy and reduce the computational complexity, based on the Weighted Least Squares (WLS) algorithm, the heating network - cooling network – power network SE is decoupled into several estimation processes with CCHP coupling alternating iterative constraint conditions. Thus, a decoupling SE method for microgrid park of integrated energy is proposed. Finally, the feasibility of the decoupling SE method and its advantages over the traditional SE method of the power network are verified by the simulations in a 59-node microgrid park with CCHP.

articleTitle: Optimization of Operation Strategy of Electric Vehicle Charging Station in Multi-station Fusion Scene
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to create a new model of energy sharing and economic reciprocity, the State Grid Company began to promote the "multi-station integration" business rapidly in 2020. The purpose is to make full use of substation resources, give full play to the value of multi-station fusion, improve the economy of multi-station fusion, and ensure the economic operation of electric vehicle charging station. In this paper, through the construction of electric vehicle charging station load model and energy storage system model, the annual comprehensive total cost of charging station is taken as the objective function and the optimal operation strategy of charging station under the background of multi-station fusion is established and verified by example analysis.

articleTitle: Power System Transient Stability Assessment and Key Bus Set Selection Based on Multiple-agent Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Transient stability assessment (TSA) plays an important role in the safe operation of power systems. With the development of computer and intelligent technologies, machine learning is likely to be used for the TSA of modern power systems due to the improved arithmetic capability. This paper proposes a new multiple-agent cooperation method for transient stability assessment. With this model, the pre-AI is responsible for selecting the key bus set of the analyzed power system. Then, the phasor measurement unit data of the key bus set is used by post-AI to generates an accurate transient stability assessment result. The IEEE 39-bus system is adopted to verify the validity of this proposed method. Results show that the proposed method can significantly reduce the calculating time as well as ensure the transient stability assessment accuracy. The AI for AI working mode provides a new insight for the serial collaboration and application of multi-agent technologies in the power system.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of simulation and measurement of photovoltaic power station participating in primary frequency regulation
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: For grid connected photovoltaic power station primary frequency regulation method, this paper selected three latest photovoltaic power station frequency regulation methods for the comparative analysis. Firstly, the models of photovoltaic inverter and photovoltaic station were constructed, and the three control methods were simulated and compared. The simulation results show that the active power frequency droop control method has more advantages than the other two control methods. In this method, the response delay time was less than 2s, the regulation time was less than 8s, the response time was less than 4s, and the active power control deviation index was controlled within 1%. Finally, the comparison and analysis of the three latest control methods were completed in the photovoltaic station, which verified the practicability of the three latest control methods and the rationality of the model.

articleTitle: Exploring the Benefit of CSP to Serve Both Electrical Load and Heat Load
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Concentrating solar power (CSP) is an emerging renewable generation technology and attracts widespread attention. Besides generating electricity only, CSP can be easily reformed to be a solar combined heat and power (SCHP) plant through extracting part of intermediate solar thermal energy to serve heat demand. Thus, SCHP can be modeled as an energy hub to realize the coordination of electric system and heat system, which is regarded as the multi-energy integration value (MEI value) of SCHP. In this paper, we describe the configuration of the SCHP plant and analyze its operation flexibility on the integration of electricity and heat power generation. A SCHP dispatch model is proposed to quantify the MEI value. The results of case study indicate the remarkable benefit of SCHP through multi-energy integration, compared with CSP.

articleTitle: Research on Voice Print Recognition of Electrical Faults Based on Attention-MFCC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The sound of electrical equipment during operation contains a lot of information about the status of power equipment. In order to extract status information to identify the operating status of power equipment, a voiceprint recognition algorithm for electrical equipment was proposed in this paper. Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) were selected as research objects. The sound of GIS with different working conditions were captured. After preprocessing like framing and windowing, Mel frequency cepstral coefficient (MFCC) were used for audio feature extraction. For the sound characteristics of power equipment, the feature extraction method uses mid-time MFCC coefficients. Meanwhile, attention mechanism was introduced to improve the recognition performance of the algorithm. Then, Deep Neural Network (DNN) was used as the feature recognition algorithm. The research results show that this algorithm can effectively identify the operating status of power equipment. Based on the MFCC acoustic model, the F1 scores of GIS under different fault conditions generally exceed 90%. Compared with the original MFCC algorithm, the Attention-MFCC algorithm are more in line with the characteristics of smooth changes in the sound energy of the power equipment.

articleTitle: A new method for testing the performance of UHF sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The ultra-high frequency(UHF) method is an effective partial discharge detection method, which is widely used for online monitoring of electrical equipment and on-site live detection. At present, effective height is an effective parameter to characterize the performance of sensors, which can reflect the sensitivity of UHF sensors to different frequency spectra in signals. However, there is a problem that the effective height cannot reflect the response degree of the sensor to the pulse signal in the time domain. This parameter only pays attention to the amplitude-frequency characteristics but ignores the phase-frequency characteristics. In order to make up for the lack of performance parameters of existing sensors, this paper proposes a new performance test system to reflect the performance of UHF sensors. Firstly, S parameters are used to get the 2 characteristics of the sensor’s effective height, and then 3 parameters of the analytical impulse response function are retrieved as sensor performance indicators. Experimental results show that this method can effectively reflect the performance of UHF sensors.

articleTitle: Twenty-seven level co-phase traction power supply system
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: For the sake of eliminating the power quality problems including negative-sequence and reactive power currents at the electric railway traction power supply system, a new type of co-phase traction power supply system (CTPSS) is proposed, which is composed of V/v traction transformers and the new multilevel power quality conditioner (MPQC) based on voltage source and current source in series. The voltage source adopts hybrid cascaded 27 level converter, and the fundamental component of its output voltage has the same frequency, the same phase and the near equal RMS value with the fundamental voltage of traction transformer secondary winding, so that there is the low level voltage in the current sources. The current source adopts the single phase three-level converter, and realizes reactive power and negative-sequence compensation by tracking the compensation current reference signal. The voltage source bears the main power of the system, and its switching frequency is low, so the power transfer efficiency of the system is high. The switching frequency of current source is high, so the system has good dynamic and steady-state response performance. This paper analyzes the system structure and its equivalent circuit, compensation current detection method and control strategy. Simulations are supplied to show that the studied scheme is valid and practicable.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of New High and Low Voltage Switching Excitation Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: the excitation source is an important part of the synchronous motor, the precision of the excitation source is often determines the control accuracy of the synchronous motor, most of the synchronous motor excitation source, often with one power supply to the power supply, it also determines the excitation source microtek thyratron trigger Angle is large, greatly reduces the power factor, reduce the efficiency. This paper proposes a new type of high and low voltage switching excitation power supply, which solves the problem of low power factor and low utilization efficiency of single power supply control, and introduces its principle, and analyzes the control strategy of this excitation power supply. Finally, the reliability of the control strategy is verified by further simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Bi-level Optimal Control Strategy of Energy Storage Participating in Power Grid Frequency Regulation Based on Multi ObjectiveGenetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the growing penetration of renewable energy sources such as wind and solar in the grid, intermittence and volatility bring many problems to the power grid, which makes the power grid lack of frequency modulation capacity and poor effect of frequency regulation. In this situation, the traditional automatic generation control (AGC), as one of the main measures of power grid frequency control, is not enough to meet the challenge of current frequency regulation. Therefore, this research proposes a new optimal control strategy. Firstly, in view of the comparative evaluation of the technical traits of conventional units and energy storage units participating in frequency modulation of grid, the frequency regulation model of energy storage combined units is established. Then, based on this, a two-level control strategy is proposed. The upper level takes economy and state of charge (SOC) as constraints, and the power is allocated based on multi-objective genetic algorithm. The lower level uses model predictive control to realize frequency optimization control. Finally, the simulation effects exhibit the effectiveness of the proposed manipulate method on MATLAB/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: Overvoltage Analysis of Submarine Cables based on Detailed Electromagnetic Transient Model
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Three-core submarine cables are mostly used in offshore wind power transmission recently. The capacitive effect of long-distance submarine cables may cause overvoltage along the line. At present, the analysis of the overvoltage in the offshore wind power transmission line is mainly based on the simplified equivalent model, but the influence of the detailed structure and characteristic parameters of the cables should not be neglected. Therefore, a detailed electromagnetic transient model of submarine cable is established in this paper. And it is used to analyze the overvoltage of the offshore wind power transmission line. Simulation results show that the detailed model of three-core submarine cable is more accurate than the simplified equivalent model. The detailed model will show a more accurate magnitude of overvoltage level which is higher than the simplified model. Besides, the importance of establishing an electromagnetic transient model is also verified in the three-phase closing overvoltage analysis.

articleTitle: Review of Seawater Desalination Load Characteristics and its Application Integrated with Clean Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: As an important adjustable power load, desalination not only contributes to clean energy consumption, but also has a very important strategic value for solving the global water shortage and realizing the sustainable development of coastal desert areas such as the Middle East and North Africa. In this paper, a variety of seawater desalination technologies and respective characteristics were introduced, including distillation, reverse osmosis, electrodialysis, and dual-purpose power and water plant. After that, the load characteristics of energy-consuming equipment for seawater desalination were analyzed. Some integration of seawater desalination technology and clean energy, including solar power desalination and wind power desalination were explained and the economic difference between desalination and the South-to-North Water Diversion Project in China were compared.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of an Energy Storage System for Peak Shaving in Industrial Pulsed Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Industrial manufacturing processes are characterized by dynamic and pulsed power applications. These applications cause a high load factor combining a high peak with low average load characteristics and lead to a waste of recuperative energy. However, at the shared DC link, higher energy efficiency can be achieved by energy recuperation using energy storage systems (ESS). This paper analyzes the dynamic power profile in the production process, using measurement-based curve fitting to acquire the front-end rectifier characteristics. Then, it introduces a flywheel energy storage system (FESS) in the DC link for peak shaving purposes. The focus of the study is to verify the feasibility and control stability if a high-speed flywheel is installed at the DC link to realize fast response for recuperation and peak shaving. From the introduction of fundamental motor modeling to the droop control simulation, this paper explicitly provides the characteristic identification for the rectifier and control design for an ESS. Frequency analysis shows which factors influence the control performance. The simulation illustrates a significant peak shaving effect with proper control configuration. The simulated control scheme is implemented by the motor inverter, a programmable logic controller and measurement devices. The FESS is integrated in a DC lab and will be tested based on the framework of the research project "DC-INDUSTRIE 2".

articleTitle: Method for Estimating the Total Distributed Photovoltaic Generation Power in a Load Region
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the simulation analysis of the power grid, the load region is usually equivalent to the load model. With the widespread access to distributed photovoltaic power generation (DPVG), the dynamic characteristics of the load region change. Therefore, when modeling the load region, the DPVG should be considered. To take the DPVG into account in load modeling, obtaining the total DPVG power in the load region is required. However, the DPVG systems connected to 380-V voltage level are only equipped with watthour meter nowadays, it is difficult to obtain the accurate total generation power or accurate total installed capacity of the DPVG systems in operation. To this end, a method to estimate the total DPVG power in the load region is proposed. First, a DPVG station with real-time power measurement in the load region will be chosen as an observation station; then, the ratio between the generation power of the DPVG observation station and the total DPVG power in the load region will be determined through the similarity of the load power in two similar days; last, the total DPVG power in the load region can be obtained by multiplying the generation power of the DPVG observation station by the estimated power ratio. Because the proposed method does not need the data of light intensity or ambient temperature, it is easy to implement. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by field measurement.

articleTitle: PSO-Based Risk Allocation in Waste-To-Energy Incineration Public-Private Partnership model
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Fair and reasonable risk sharing mechanism is beneficial to reduce the risk of investment and improve the economic benefits of Waste-To-Energy incineration projects project investment. In order to quantitatively study the risk allocation ratio of PPP Waste-To-Energy incineration projects, an intelligent optimization algorithm is used to solve the problem. Based on the utility model of government and enterprise, the risk sharing model is established by introducing the altruistic preference coefficient. In this paper the relationship between the altruistic preference coefficient, the risk-sharing ratio and the maximum utility value of government and firm qualitatively are studied. PSO algorithm is used to determine the altruistic preference coefficient, the government’s risk-sharing ratio and the enterprise’s effort.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Analysis Method for Spatial Coupling of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the development of energy revolution, the proportion of renewable energy in the power system is increasing, which makes the impact of the spatial coupling between wind power or photovoltaic power on power systems more significantly. Therefore, it is necessary to calculate and analyze the spatial coupling of renewable energy (RE). This paper constructs a calculation method of the correlation of RE power generation between different areas, which can give strategies for the coordinated development of RE in different areas. Simultaneously, this paper also analyzes the complementarity of wind power and photovoltaic power in the same area and calculates the optimal proportion of wind-photovoltaic installed capacity. In the case study, we analyze the spatial coupling of RE of a real power system in China, and give the development suggestions of RE, which verifies the rationality and applicability of this method.

articleTitle: A coordinated control strategy of reactive power compensation for offshore wind power system with AC transmission
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In recent years, offshore wind power has been vigorously developed. High voltage AC transmission is one of the main grid connection technologies for offshore wind power. Submarine cable has more charging power causing the problem of overvoltage more prominent. To solve the problem of line overvoltage in the AC transmission system of the offshore wind power, this paper proposes a coordinated reactive power control strategy. First, the reactive power generated by wind turbine is considered to reduce the configuration capacity of the reactive power compensation devices. Second, the reactive power compensation is divided into two parts: the land side and the wind power collecting side. Then, with the objective function of minimizing the power loss and the voltage offset, the assignment of the optimal amount of reactive power on both sides is solved. Finally, simulation results prove that the line overvoltage suppression effect of dual-terminal coordinated control strategy proposed in this paper is both economical and effective.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Economic Benefits of Different Types of PV Systems in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Photovoltaic energy is an important part of green energy, and the photovoltaic industry has grown rapidly. Photovoltaic systems are often considered to have low economic benefits, but with the drop-in module prices and government subsidies, economic benefits should be reviewed. This paper uses PVSOL software to simulate photovoltaic systems with different load profiles, photovoltaic systems with residential and commercial loads. Through the simulation analysis, the most economical photovoltaic system design proposal is given, which provides a reference for future PV design.

articleTitle: Analysis of unbalanced current malfunction of series complement capacitor bank
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In this paper, the unbalanced current of the capacitor bank exceeds the boundary in the Panlong I line series repair device of 500 kV fengjie series repair station is taken as an example and the wiring mode of the non-fuse capacitor bank of the station, the configuration of the unbalanced current protection and the theoretical calculation method of the unbalanced degree are introduced. Through the simulation and analysis of the malfunction of capacitor elements inside the capacitor, the influence of different number of capacitor elements breakdown on the capacitance of single capacitor and single series capacitor bank is determined, and the number of failed capacitors that lead to the increase of unbalanced current is inferred. Again by not hurting head and part of the head down the single string, combining the two ways of rapid capacitor of capacitance measurement and eliminating a line after the influence of external factors, such as induction, then quickly completing fault capacitor in series of positioning, finally finding fault by means of only one measurement capacitor and being successful in the balance and replacement, and making it possible to be proved both by the measurement and theoretical speculation to complete the defects of excessive unbalanced current processing. After putting the equipment into operation, the change belonging to unbalanced current of capacitor bank is measured in a certain period of time and the influence of sunshine temperature difference on the unbalanced current of capacitor bank is inferred and the optimization idea of reverse balance of capacitor bank is put forward.

articleTitle: Design of High and Low Voltage Switching High Precision Excitation Power Supply for Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Synchronous condenser is a good reactive power compensation equipment in power grid. In recent years, with the development of UHVDC transmission, the characteristics of "Strong HVDC and Weak AC" in the power grid have become more and more obvious, so the demand for reactive power compensation is also increasing. Compared with SVC and SVG, synchronous condenser has a larger reactive power compensation capacity, and its reactive power compensation status is getting higher and higher. The reactive power compensation characteristics of synchronous condenser are determined by the characteristics of its excitation power supply. In this paper, a high and low voltage switching type high-precision excitation power supply is designed, its principle is introduced, and the simulation analysis is carried out in PSIM simulation software. Finally, a 1kW low power device is developed and designed to carry out experimental verification.

articleTitle: A Time Synchronization Method for Wireless Sensors Array of Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Accurate time labeling and unified time reference are the important premise of the practical application for the wireless sensors array of Power Internet of Things. The existing time synchronization algorithms for wireless sensor cannot balance the power consumption and synchronization accuracy. Based on the principle of hierarchical broadcasting, this paper proposes a time synchronization algorithm with low power consumption and high accuracy, which is suitable for wireless sensors. The algorithm first classes the sensors to different layers and levels, and then synchronizes each layer and each level of sensors according to the broadcast synchronization method. Thus, it can reduce the synchronization power consumption and the intermediate links to ensure the synchronization accuracy. The simulation results show that the method proposed can improve the synchronization accuracy to microsecond level, and the power consumption is reduced by about 85% compared with the traditional broadcast algorithms.

articleTitle: Multi-Start Strategy based Global Optimization Method for Ambient Signal-based Load Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Load modeling is critical for power system transient analysis and simulation. In recent studies, ambient signal-based parameter identification is considered as an effective method to obtain time-varying model parameters. However, low fluctuation amplitude of ambient signals may exacerbate the issue of multiple local optimal solutions, which is derived from the nonconvex and nonlinear characteristics of parameter identification problem. In this paper, a multi-start strategy based global optimization method is presented for ambient signal-based load parameter identification. Firstly, the selection of start points is formulated as a maximum diversity problem which can be solved by greedy algorithm. Then, we apply trust region-based local solvers to identify model parameters and obtain global optimum from multiple local solutions. Simulation results in the IEEE-39 bus system have demonstrated the global accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Overview of Adjustable Reactor
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the specific application of adjustable reactor, expounds its development history and research trend, and classifies the existing adjustable reactors according to their regulation modes. For various types of adjustable reactors, the working principle is introduced in detail, the structure diagram is given, and some application examples are introduced. Some special types of adjustable reactor are also introduced, such as virtual air gap adjustable reactor, magnetic circuit transfer type adjustable reactor, etc. Then, the performances of various adjustable reactors are compared and analyzed, and their advantages and disadvantages are summarized, and their application prospects are preliminarily evaluated.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis System for GT Control System Based on DB and Separation of Front and Back Ends
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Large gas turbine control system fail during operation inevitably. Due to the various failure causes and failure modes, the troubleshooting process is relatively complicated. Combining the current situation of gas turbine control system fault diagnosis, the fault examples of the gas turbine control system are sorted out and summarized into five types of faults. Using distributed database, micro-service framework Spring Cloud, front-end framework Vue.js, following the principle of separation of front-end and back-end , carry out the design and development of the fault diagnosis system for GT control system based on B/S architecture, so that power plant staff can use the system to analyze and diagnose faults, and improve the accuracy and efficiency of fault diagnosis of the GT control system.

articleTitle: Power System State Estimation Based on PMU Under Linear Bayesian Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the rapid changes in the actual power system operation mode, power system wide area real time state estimation based on phasor measurement unit (PMU) plays an increasingly important role in energy management system (EMS). However, complex distribution characteristics of PMU measurement error pose challenges to the accuracy of state estimation. Therefore, a state estimation method combining PMU linear measurement model and linear Bayesian estimation is proposed. Considering the prior information of estimated parameters and the complex probability density function of measurement error, linear Bayesian estimation is applied to power system state estimation based on PMU. The correlation between real measurement error and imaginary measurement error is analyzed, and the prior information of estimated parameters is obtained according to the analysis of system state volatility. Compared with complex number least squares (CLS) method, the applicability and accuracy of this method were verified in IEEE 39 bus system.

articleTitle: Application and discussion of key technologies for the integration of high-temperature Electrostatic Precipitator + SCR denitrification in the cement industry
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasingly stringent NOx emission standards for the flue gas of cement kiln, the development and application of selective catalytic reduction (SCR technology) is imperative. The SCR denitrification technology for cement kiln is divided into multiple technical paths according to different temperature ranges, dust concentrations and layout locations. Based on our company s application case under the specific working conditions of 350 °C high temperature and up to 180g/Nm3 dust concentration, the key points of the process for our company's high temperature electrostatic precipitator + SCR denitrification integrated technology are discussed to provide the application experience of SCR technology for cement kiln.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Performance Evaluation Of Frequency Control Of Pumped Storage Units Based On Actual Operating Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: As the "regulator" of the power system, the pumped storage power station has the advantages of flexible working condition conversion, fast adjustment speed, and short response time. Compared with thermal power units, pumped storage units participate in the primary frequency control(PFC) and secondary frequency control (Automatic Generation Control, AGC) more frequently. Learning from the "Implementation Rules for Auxiliary Service Management of Grid-connected Power Plants and Implementation Rules for Grid-connected Operation Management of Power Plants(Two Rules)"of the six major regional power systems in China, this article firstly establishes a comprehensive performance evaluation system of frequency control for pumped storage units; On this basis, we determine the weight of each index according to the unit's frequency control reserve capacity; Finally, based on the actual operating data of a pumped storage power station in North China, we use the TOPSIS evaluation method to evaluate the performance of PFC, the performance of AGC and the comprehensive performance of frequency control of each unit in the station, and compare the evaluation results.

articleTitle: The Research of Influence of TCPST on Subsynchronous Oscillation Based on Complex Torque Coefficient Method
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In recent years, more and more Flexible AC Transmission System (FACTS) devices have been used in power systems, making subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) more and more serious. Thyristor Controlled Phase Shifting Transformer (TCPST), as an advanced FACTS device, can alleviate SSO effectively. In this paper, PSCAD is used to build the transient model of the second standard test system with TCPST, and the complex torque coefficient method based on simulation analysis— test signal method is used to study how TCPST will influence the system's SSO under different conditions. The result of simulation indicates that TCPST can alleviate and even suppress SSO effectively.

articleTitle: Study on thermal effect analysis method of heat-resistant fiber composite low-voltage cable under different working conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Optic fiber composite low voltage cable (OPLC) is a kind of special power cable, which is composed of optical fiber in the low voltage cable, so that the cable has the function of optical fiber communication at the same time of power transmission. OPLC is an important component in the power system. In the running state, the transient high temperature on the composite cable has a negative effect on the transmission performance of the optical fiber in the photoelectric composite low-voltage cable to some extent. Aiming at this problem, this article from the perspective of OPLC heat type, based on the structure characteristics of OPLC heat-resistant type, and optimization method, using simulation software COMSOL more physical field, electromagnetic field theory, the basic theory, such as heat transfer of different working condition of different structure type heat resistant OPLC simulation modeling, explores the endurance of OPLC simulation analysis method, The thermal effect data of heat-resistant OPLC under different working conditions were obtained to further verify the structural effectiveness of heat-resistant OPLC.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Analysis of High-altitude Electromagnetic Pulse at System Level
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: High-altitude electromagnetic pulse (HEMP) has the characteristics of high peak value, wide coverage and wide spectrum, which can destroy a lot of power electronic equipment, thus leading to system failure. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the system-level vulnerability of HEMP. In this paper, a vulnerability analysis method combining electromagnetic topology (EMT) and fault tree (FT) is proposed. In this qualitative analysis, the coupling relationship between HEMP and each component is presented, and the system fault model under HEMP is established based on the EMT and FT. The Taylor model of the transmission line is used to calculate the terminal induced current response. Combined with the vulnerability curve of components, the vulnerability of the system fault model under HEMP is analyzed by Monte Carlo methods. The proposed method is used to simulate the microcontroller system, and the simulation results show that the proposed method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: An Entity Recognition Approach of GIS Fault Text
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Entity recognition of GIS fault text contributes to the manual experience sharing and the execution efficiency of GIS operation and maintenance. However, traditional models have poor performance on such entity recognition tasks. In this paper, a novel entity recognition model is proposed. The model consists of several single-type entity recognizers, which increase the accuracy of the model. Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers (BERT) is also applied to understand the characters in the text. Experiments show that the proposed model can achieve F1-score of 88.0%. Compared with other traditional entity recognition models, the performance of the proposed model is improved by about 20%.

articleTitle: Chance-constrained Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Gas-electric System
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the exhaustion of non-renewable energy and the increasing energy demands around the world, the penetration of renewable energy has gradually increased. However, due to the strong uncertainty of wind generation and insufficient capacity of the power system to adopt wind generation, the phenomenon of wind curtailment occurs frequently. Therefore, in order to improve the accommodation ability of power system, an optimal scheduling model was proposed to minimize the total operation cost of integrated gas-electric system considering the uncertainty of wind power. The uncertainty of wind generation was described by strong expansion formulation of the sample average approximation, and the natural gas flow equation was linearized by Taylor series expansion, and then the optimization scheduling problem of nonlinear integrated gas-electric system was converted into a mixed integer linear programming model for the solution. Simulation results show that the proposed model can enhance the adoption of wind power.

articleTitle: Extreme learning machine based short-term wind power prediction framework with adaptive variational mode decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: a novel extreme learning machine(ELM) based short-term wind power forecasting framework with adaptive variational mode decomposition(VMD) is put forward. First, adaptive VMD approach is developed to decompose the raw historical wind power sequence into multiple intrinsic mode functions(IMFs) to get rid of the random noise and extract the trend and harmonics. Then ELM model, which is respectively trained by using every IMF of the wind power training set as input, is employed to predict wind power. What is more, the prediction results are reconstructed to achieve higher prediction accuracy. Finally, compared with the LSTM, SVR, ELM and ARIMA model, the proposed model gets the optimum performance that be desired in short-term wind power forecasting.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of PPP Waste to Energy Generation Based on Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Due to the large number of participants in PPP projects, long operation period, large investment and other factors, the project risk factors have a high degree of ambiguity and randomness. In order to accurately carry out the risk evaluation of PPP projects, this paper proposes a risk evaluation method based on cloud model. Firstly, select the main risk factors and establish a risk factor identification system. At the same time, according to the expert evaluation method and principles of comment index, establish the main risk evaluation index system, and then use improved fuzzy analytic hierarchy process method and entropy weight method to obtain the weight of the risk from the subjective and objective perspectives. According to the reverse cloud model algorithm to obtain the digital characteristics of the secondary risk. The digital characteristics of the secondary risk and the weight are combined to finally obtain the digital characteristics of the total risk of the PPP project, and the forward cloud model generator is used to obtain the cloud model of the total risk. Then according to the cloud model, the risk level standard cloud is given, and the risk level is determined by comparing the similarity of the two cloud images. This paper takes the PPP waste incineration power generation project as an example to verify the proposed method. The results show that the method is effective and scientific, which can provide a reference for future risk assessment of PPP projects.

articleTitle: Study on Establishment of Prognostics and Health Management System for Vessels
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Difficulties are being brought to maintenance support of vessels along with the continuous improvement in degrees of intelligence, information-based development and integration of equipment for vessels. The strategy of maintenance for the current vessels combines regular maintenance with breakdown maintenance and is hard to comply with the requirements on precise maintenance support for vessels. Therefore, transformation of strategy of maintenance for vessels to health-oriented maintenance is an irresistible trend of development for equipment maintenance support. The basic way to implement the health-oriented maintenance is the prognostics and health management (PHM) technology. In this paper, firstly the top-level architecture of the PHM system for vessels is established on the basis of detailed analysis of connotations and effects of PHM technology to clearly define the main functional modules for the system; secondly, basic technologies necessary for realizing the PHM are analyzed; and finally, a technical index system of PHM for vessels is established, for the purpose of providing indexes related to health management capabilities in such aspects as performance, general quality characteristics and design constraints and of providing references for study on PHM technology for vessel equipment, corresponding systematic design analysis, verification and assessment and breakthrough of key technologies in the future.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Battery Energy Storage in the Wind-Thermal-Hydro Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In view of the high proportion of wind power integration that has brought challenges to the operation of traditional thermal-hydro power system, this paper establishes an optimal planning model of battery energy storage (BES) based on robust optimization framework for wind-thermal-hydro power system. Considering that the planning problem of BES is coupled with its operation problem, this paper takes into account the uncertainty and accommodation capacity of wind power in the operation stage, so as to ensure the effectiveness of the optimal solution in the feasible intervals. At the same time, based on the number of equivalent full cycles of BES in the process of discharging, this paper considers the constraints of BES’s investment capacity to ensure the economy of the decision-making. The proposed planning model of BES in the wind-thermal-hydro power system is finally transformed into a bi-level mixed integer linear programming model, which can be solved by efficient commercial solvers. Furthermore, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method are analyzed and verified on the modified IEEE 30-bus system. The comparative analyses show that the proposed method can balance the actual life of BES and the economy of its operation. Moreover, the flexible adjustment capabilities of hydropower units can help reduce the planned capacity and the number of locations for BES. Also, the planned water flow and the BES’s investment capacity are mutually constrained.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis and Research on Investment Return of Energy Storage Participating in Thermal Power Peak and Frequency Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In recent years, large-scale new energy sources such as wind power and photovoltaics have been connected to the grid, which has brought challenges to the stability and safe operation of the power system. As an auxiliary service, energy storage system participates in frequency regulation and peak load regulation of thermal power plants, which can not only assist the thermal power generating set to meet the requirements of fast frequency regulation and peak regulation of the power grid, but also realize the balance of power supply and demand in the grid. This paper establishes the whole life cycle cost model of energy storage system, such as initial investment, operation and maintenance, depreciation cost, revenue and compensation model of energy storage participating in ancillary services, and tax cost model considering the actual operation of energy storage system. Finally, it evaluates and analyzes the economic indicators of energy storage system through an actual example.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Si and SiC Based 27 kW DC-DC Converters with Ferrite Cores for Fuell Cell Hybrid Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Literature compares DC-DC converters with Si and SiC power semiconductors without optimum switching frequency in terms of efficiency, volume, and costs for the respective application and operating point. Typical switching frequencies, such as 25 kHz for Si-IGBTs and 100 kHz for SiC-MOSFETs, are chosen with unconditional statements. A design with optimum switching frequency is crucial for a meaningful conclusion about the best-suited semiconductor technology for the respective application. This paper uses a novel iterative design procedure to determine the optimum switching frequency considering a trade-off between efficiency, volume, and costs for bidirectional DC-DC converters based on Si-IGBTs and SiC-MOSFETs with ferrite cores. Due to the importance of fuel cell hybrid vehicles as the long-term alternative to conventional vehicles, the application analyzed is the bidirectional DC-DC converter connecting the traction battery to the DC-bus. Both converters are evaluated and compared in the simulation environment PSIM, and their parameters are according to available fuel cell hybrid vehicles on the market. This paper proves in PSIM that the optimum switching frequency in both cases is below the standard values. Furthermore, it presents that Si-IGBTs have efficiency losses of less than 2 % for the operating point of interest than SiC-MOSFETs, reducing semiconductor costs by 68 % while increasing core volume by 344 %.

articleTitle: Power Distribution Transformer Fault Diagnosis with Unbalanced Samples Based on Neighborhood Component Analysis and k-Nearest Neighbors
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the power distribution transformer fault diagnosis method based on machine learning techniques, the imbalance of the number of cases among various fault categories will lead to a decrease in the accuracy of the fault diagnosis. In order to improve the accuracy and operating efficiency of the power distribution transformer fault diagnosis model, a fault diagnosis model combining the nearest neighbor component analysis with the introduction of correction factors and k-nearest neighbor learning is proposed. Firstly, a correction factor is introduced to the objective function of the neighborhood component analysis algorithm (NCA) to reduce the impact of sample imbalance on model training. Then, the k-nearest neighbors (kNN) classifier is used to map and transform the input data to reduce the distance between samples of the same type, thereby improving the classification performance of kNN. Finally, use the Bayesian optimization algorithm to tune the hyperparameters of the model, and obtain the model parameter set with the highest accuracy of the test set. The analysis results of the calculation examples based on the transformer fault case library show that the proposed model has improved computational efficiency and accuracy of classification results compared with the traditional machine learning diagnosis model. The research of this paper can provide references for the fault diagnosis of power distribution transformer.

articleTitle: Application Topology Configuration of Distributed Feeder Automation Based on IEC 61850
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Distributed feeder automation (FA) needs to automatically recognize the real time feeder topology changes and configure the application topology of the corresponding distributed functions. This paper analyzes the requirements of the application topology when implementing distributed FA for the feeder with both smart terminal unit (STU) and fault passage indicator (FPI) installed. Based on IEC 61850, the functional logic node and topology configuration of intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) are studied. The application topology identification and data flow dynamic binding methods for fault location, fault isolation and power supply restoration are proposed. A study case verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fault Interval Judgment of Urban Distribution Grid Based on Edge Computing of Distribution Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The emergence of the Internet of Things has promoted the development of the transmission and processing of information in the distribution grid. More and more automation and intelligent devices are deployed in the distribution grid, bringing a considerable amount of data information, which far exceeds the processing and service capacity of the main station in the regional distribution information network center. Under this background, the edge computing model, which distributes the data computing tasks originally undertaken by the main station of distribution information network center among the host nodes of each edge computing node in the system, is proposed. The urban power distribution network, mainly in the form of switching stations and terminal structures, is suitable for management and organization by adopting edge computing mode. In this paper, a single-phase grounding fault diagnosis method for distribution grid, which is applied on the internal edge computing host of a switching station, is introduced. Whether there is a grounding fault in the management area and where the fault occurs are determined by comparing the difference of zero-sequence electrical quantity of multiple lines with the edge computing node host. The validity of the algorithm is verified by a real field experiment.

articleTitle: Active and Reactive Power Coordinated Control of Active Distribution Networks Based on Prioritized Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy, voltage violation and network loss problems have hindered the secure and efficient operation of active distribution networks (ADN). Therefore, properly utilizing the reactive power of the inverter-based energy resources is inevitable. However, in the ADNs, active and reactive power (P&Q) are coupled both in the capacity and in the power flow. Moreover, the models of complicated ADNs are hard to maintain since the operation budget is limited and environment varies all the time. Hence, we develop an active and reactive power coordinated control of ADNs based on reinforcement learning (RL), which learns the control policy from interactions between the controller and the ADN. Since the RL-based method is designed for online application, our proposed method utilizes prioritized experience replay to promote efficiency and optimality. Comparing with traditional P&Q coordinated control methods, our method does not require the accurate model of ADN, but can achieve near-optimal state with high sample efficiency. Numerical simulations not only demonstrate the superiority on eliminating voltage violation, reducing network loss and maximizing the system economy, but also show the improvement of our proposed method comparing with existing RL-based methods.

articleTitle: A Study of Transfer Entropy Network on Interprovince Dynamics in Industrial Electricity Consumption
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Based on the fact that electricity consumption is an objective indicator of industrial activities, an assumption is made that interregional industrial driving and transferring effect can be also reflected in electricity consumption data. A study of transfer entropy network is performed on monthly electricity consumption volume of the secondary industry in provinces of Yangtze River Economic Belt. First, the data are preconditioned with seasonal decomposition to obtain the overall trend which mainly results from macroeconomic environment. Then, causality analysis is made between the electricity consumption trends of provinces. Transfer entropy theory is applied for its ability to provide quantitative strength as well as direction of the causal relationship. With transfer entropy matrix, degree of asymmetric information flow is calculated to measure the intensity of the driving-and-driven relationship of the secondary industry between provinces. The result coincides with the fact that the eastern coastal provinces play a leading and driving role in the coordinated development of the zone. Furthermore, based on Chu-Liu-Edmonds algorithm, a maximum spanning arborescence network is constructed for the provinces in the zone. Such a network describes a most direct spreading route of driving effect and is potential in providing decision support of macroeconomic adjustment.

articleTitle: Multi-source flexible grid disaster recovery smart plan optimization evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The traditional power grid disaster recovery plan has been unable to adapt to today's multi-source feeding new power grid structure. Based on the indicators of the traditional disaster recovery plan, this paper adds new indicators that adapt to the characteristics of the new power grid structure, and builds a new disaster recovery plan evaluation system that adapts to the contemporary power grid. It also proposes a comprehensive weight modeling method that combines the D-AHP and Poisson distribution methods to determine the index weight and time weight. Finally, the TOPSIS method is used to solve the problem of a new regional power grid. Sort the programs. The results of calculation examples show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively evaluate the scientific nature of the new power grid disaster recovery plan.

articleTitle: Optimal Battery and PV Sizing of Charging Stations Considering Battery Dynamic Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To reduce the carbon emissions from vehicles and realize carbon neutrality, it is necessary to promote the application of battery energy storage system (BESS) and photovoltaic (PV) in electric vehicle charging stations. Meanwhile, the implementation of BESS and PV in charging stations can be a solution to help to reduce the progressively increase of the charging load in energy distribution networks. Finding the optimal size of BESS and PV is necessary for charging stations to save long-term costs. In our paper, a novel refined BESS model considering BESS dynamic characteristic is established, which takes BESS operation characteristics of dynamic capacity, dynamic lifetime and dynamic efficiency into account. Based on the established BESS model, a bi-level optimization method is proposed to find out the optimal BESS and PV capacity, and the optimal solution is found by using a genetic algorithm (GA) with elitist strategy. Then a case study of a charging station in Shanghai proves the effectiveness of the proposed method. The simulation results confirm that: 1) the BESS and PV size can be determined for optimal benefits by the proposed model; 2) the proposed refined BESS model, which considers BESS dynamic characteristics, is feasible; 3) the proposed operation strategy in typical days, could improve the benefits and the energy consumption of the PV systems for the operator of the charging stations.

articleTitle: Fault Identification in Power Distribution Systems based on Domain Adaptation Probabilistic Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To improve the fault identification accuracy in power distribution systems, a diagnosis method for incipient faults is proposed based on Domain Adaption Probabilistic Learning. The proposed method finds the best linear mapping by waveform decomposition and feature similarity, which maps simulation data and field data into the same feature space. In this space, the distribution difference between two kinds of features reaches its minimum, allowing the model to use simulation data for training and field data for test. The whole process solves the essential problem of few samples in fault identification. Experiments show that this method is much better than other commonly-used classification models, such as Convolutional Neural Network, Support Vector Machine and K-nearest Neighbors, in the aspects of reliability and accuracy. This research provides a new idea for fault identification in power distribution systems under the condition of domain adaptation.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Modulation Control Strategy and Economic Dispatch Model Based on Multi-source Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of decreasing frequency regulation capability of multi-source integrated power grids with increasing penetration rate of new energy, this paper proposes a joint frequency regulation method based on traditional conventional unit frequency regulation and supplemented by new energy field stations and energy storage power stations. The frequency modulation dead zone is used as the division interval of the joint frequency modulation strategy, so that the joint frequency modulation of multi-source generators can be applied to the daily operation of the power grid. At the same time, establish a multi-objective joint economic dispatch model that takes into account the cost of frequency modulation, frequency stability indicators and the main operator’s income, convert the frequency stability indicators into a penalty cost function, and use the Mixed Integer Linear Programming (Mixed Integer Linear Programming, MILP) method to solve the model . Finally, the simulation results of a calculation example show that the joint scheduling model can effectively reduce the system scheduling cost and increase the revenue.

articleTitle: Market Power Assessment of the Central America Regional Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper focuses the attention on the market power assessment of the Central American Regional Electric Market. First, the characteristics of the market under study are described, then five measures are used to evaluate the market power of the agents. Furthermore, this paper develops a method to consider the transmission restrictions that occur in the regional electrical system. The authors used historical data from 2017 to 2020 to make the calculations; the results obtained are presented where it is observed that the possibilities of exercising market power for agents have been increasing through the years, and Costa Rica is the country with the highest probability of exercising it.

articleTitle: Seismic Vulnerability Analysis of High Voltage Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Transformers are one of the most essential electrical equipment in a substation, assessing their seismic withstand capacity is of great significance to sustain the normal function of substation. To evaluate the earthquake resistance performance of a 500 kV transformer, a finite element model of a whole transformer system composed of tank, turrets and bushings was first established. And dynamic properties and time history analysis were carried out to find its most vulnerable points. Then seismic vulnerability analysis can be conducted using the incremental dynamic analysis (IDA) method. Results show that the dynamic amplification of the tank and turret to the bushing is much larger than the threshold of 2.0 specified in the relevant codes, and the root section of the high voltage (HV) bushing is the most vulnerable and it is not likely to be acceptable for the ground motions with a peak ground acceleration (PGA) of 0.3 g, which is even less than the local fortification intensity. Therefore, the influence of transformer tank and turrets can not be ignored when evaluating the seismic performance of a transformer bushing, and some retrofitting measures should be taken to enhance their seismic withstand capacity.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Strategy for Concentrating Solar Power toward High Penetration of Renewables
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: As an emerging form of renewable energy generation, concentrating solar power (CSP) plant has the inertia and dispatchability like conventional power supply, and its flexible operation mode has significant advantages in promoting the accommodation of renewables. However, insufficient flexibility might cause massive solar energy curtailment. Therefore,a mixed integer linear programming scheduling model in this paper is established to coordinate the joint optimal operation of CSP and other generation resources, i.e., wind, thermal and hydropower, aiming at minimizing the total operation costs. Case studies demonstrate that the operation cost of CSP plant can be significantly reduced, which is 4.62% lower than the natural output, and the equivalent load variance of CSP is 36.65% lower than the natural output. We also discover that the optimal operation of CSP plant can mitigate the emission of air pollutants, and meanwhile enhance the consumption level of clean energy, which is conducive to the low-carbon development of future power systems.

articleTitle: Optimal Bidding Strategy for Energy Hub Incorporating Data Center Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of internet technology, data center has become a critical facility for data storage and processing while consuming an increasing amount of electricity in recent years. Previous studies mostly focus on the data center energy management of the servers in a data center, nevertheless ignoring an efficient utilization of its waste heat. Therefore, we propose an optimal bidding strategy for an energy hub while taking advantage of the waste heat from a data center. Instead of releasing the waste heat directly into external environment, our major idea is to recover such energy for building’s space heating that reduces the power consumption from air conditioning. In this paper, a detailed model of data center operation is formulated considering its demand response capability and heat recirculating. A day-ahead market bidding model for an energy hub is formulated considering the flexibility of the data center as well as the cooperation of various forms of distributed energy resources (DERs). Case studies based on a real-world data center demonstrate that the proposed bidding strategy can increase the benefits of the energy hub and improve energy efficiency by making use of waste heat.

articleTitle: Coordinated wind power dispatch model for an integrated heat and power system by a novel scenario-dependent algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Combined heat and power (CHP) units required to meet high heat demands over heating periods in North China have high power injections into electrical grids, greatly aggravating the wind generation curtailment. To deal with this issue, this paper develops a coordinated wind power dispatch model for the CHP units which are integrated with a thermal energy storage (TES) and an electric boiler (EB) placed at the CHP thermal output side and power demand side respectively. The dispatch model optimises the operation of all the components integrated within the system by minimising the total dispatch cost associated with electricity and heat generation and wind curtailment. The CHP thermoelectric coupling constraint is decoupled based on a scenario decomposing strategy where the feasible operation region of CHP units is converted into inequality constratins, permitting to solve the economic dispatch problem by the use of a scenario-dependent elitist genetic algorithm combind with an interior point method. The coordinated dispatch model is tested on a modified IEEE 30-bus system with different combinations of TES and EB. The dispatch results show that the proposed model can optimise the schedules of TES and EB to maximise the use of wind generation and lower the overall dispatch cost across the plan time horizon. In addition, the relationship between the EB heat-supply propotion and the dispatch cost is discussed.

articleTitle: Evaluation Tags Calculation of Relay Protection Equipment Based on Improved Metric Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Extracting characteristic attribute sets covering device ontology, operating state, maintenance and other equipment life trajectory process, establishing the tagging model of relay protection equipment and comprehensively displaying the protection equipment information, which can provide technical support for the operation, maintenance and technical upgrading of relay protection equipment efficiently. This paper analyzes the basic attributes and behavior attributes of the relay protection equipment, and establishes the tagging device model of the relay protection equipment including static class, dynamic class and evaluation class. The basic attributes and behavior attributes of relay protection equipment are analyzed, and the improved measurement learning algorithm is used, that is, the index function of applicability is introduced, the appropriate mapping matrix is searched, and the evaluation tags of protection equipment are established. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Seismic Performance and Vulnerability Analysis of High Voltage Capacitor
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Capacitors are basic components used in filter loops of high voltage substations. However, in recent earthquake events, capacitors have proved to be vulnerable for their significant mass, high center of gravity and fragility of ceramic insulators. To comprehensively analyze seismic performance and vulnerability, a sophisticated finite element model of a typical capacitor was built, and nonlinear time-history analysis with 7 different ground motions was carried out to obtain the seismic responses and weak positions of the capacitor. Moreover, failure criteria for two evaluation levels were defined. The incremental dynamic analysis (IDA) with dozens of input ground motions was adopted to calculate the failure probability. Results indicate that the bottom insulator is the weakest positions during earthquakes. Moreover, the first two shearing-type modes of the capacitor play dominant roles in its seismic responses, and the torsion effect can be ignored even the bidirectional earthquake is input. According to the vulnerability analysis, failure probability of the capacitor grows rapidly when the peak ground acceleration (PGA) reaches 0.4 g. In summary, the capacitor would be extreme vulnerable in areas of high seismic intensity. Increase the material strength or section arears of the bottom insulator can reduce the failure probability by 40% at most.

articleTitle: Cooperative Scheduling of Power-Thermal Coupled System in Park Based on Chaotic Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: For the northwest region with abundant new energy resources, it is the trend of energy Internet development to change the traditional heating mode through power substitution and multi-functional coordination and complementary. However, due to the fluctuation of new energy sources and the multi-time scale characteristics of the electric-thermal coupling system, the study of reasonable and feasible energy scheduling strategies has become an urgent problem to be solved. This paper studies the coordinated optimal dispatch of the electric-thermal coupling system for the regional energy network at the park level. Aiming at economy and environmental protection, a multi-objective chaotic particle swarm algorithm is presented. The initial population and the search process are more traversable by population initialization method based on chaos generation, penalty-based overrun correction method, and chaotic search-based particle movement method, and the particles are not allowed to enter the infeasible domain. To achieve the coordinated optimal dispatch of the deep electric-thermal coupling "source-load" system in the park. The simulation results show that compared with other multi-objective optimization algorithms, this algorithm has better convergence performance, and the optimization results are significantly reduced in terms of power consumption, total maintenance cost and carbon dioxide emissions, so it can better solve the co-scheduling problem of the electric-thermal coupling system.

articleTitle: A Novel Localization Method for the Partial Discharge of Transformer based on UHF
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Partial discharge(PD) diagnosis and location is helpful to find the fault location of high-voltage power device in the early aging stage, and has important reference value for making maintenance plan. Now, many ultra high frequency (UHF) are often used to form sensor array, and three-dimensional coordinate system is defined to locate the partial discharge of transformer. In this paper, the principle of capturing the initial pulse of signal based on energy accumulation method and positioning based on time difference of arrival (TDOA) algorithm is studied. A nonlinear programming problem with the coordinates of partial discharge points as unknowns is constructed, and the tabu search particle swarm optimization (TS-PSO) algorithm is used to solve the optimal solution. The algorithm can avoid the problems of nonconvergence and nonuniqueness in solving nonlinear equations and the high initial value requirements of least square method. It can not only ensure the speed of solution, but also ensure the uniqueness and accuracy of solution. Laboratory and on-site tests verify the effectiveness of the positioning results.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control of Energy Prosumer Based on NSGA-II-interior Point Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of distributed new energy sources, energy storage devices and electric vehicles, the number of user-level energy prosumer in the power grid will increase. For this reason, the hardware experimental platform for ordinary user-level energy prosumer is studied to achieve the goal of high integration and collaboration of internal energy and information flow. The platform uses AC/DC coupling hardware topology structure. Users can check the working condition and control the working status through the upper computer system, including manual mode and intelligent mode. On this basis, a NSGA-II-interior point algorithm is proposed for energy management in intelligent mode, and the link between the interior point method and NSGA - II algorithm is realized by the Ɛ constraint method, which not only gives full play to the global optimization ability of heuristic algorithm, but also makes up for the defect that the numerical optimization method depends on the initial point. Finally, the transient test proves that the experimental platform has good transient response performance; the steady-state test proves that the algorithm converges better, and the power scheme with lower cost and higher comfort can be obtained, which can solve the problem of "source storage load" collaborative scheduling of energy prosumer more effectively.

articleTitle: Operation optimization of regional integrated energy system considering demand response of cooling, heating and electricity flexible loads
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: How to promote the green and low-carbon transformation and ensure the supply reliability of the energy system has become an urgent problem to be solved on the development road of regional integrated energy system (RIES). In recent years, demand response plays an important role in reducing peak load, improving system reliability and power market flexibility. However, most of the existing demand response researches still study from the perspective of electricity system, do not fully consider the impact of other energy sources such as heat and cold on the system operation, and fail to take into account the economic benefits of both users and system. Therefore, the operation optimization model of RIES considering the demand response of cooling, heating and electricity flexible loads is established. In the model, the flexible loads are divided into translatable load, dispatched load and reducible load based on the energy consumption characteristics and the demand response potential. Simultaneously, the minimum comprehensive evaluation index is taken as the objective function to optimize the operation strategy and the load demand response plan of RIES. The results of case analysis show that the total cost of RIES and the peak to valley ratio of electricity is reduced by 3.70%, 27.6%, separately, which verifies the feasibility and practicability of the model.

articleTitle: The Planning Design of Cloud Energy Storage System for Vehicle-Grid by Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper proposed a prospective research on the planning design of cloud energy storage system for vehicle-grid having vehicle-to-grid (V2G) and non V2G electric vehicle by blockchain as a future demonstration project option. The available vehicle-grid participators and planning design method of the dispatch platform is analyzed considering the actual dispatch center. The framework of vehicle-grid, flow chart for demand response and ancillary service, geographic communication mode are introduced. The potential and infrastructure investment for the vehicle-grid are discussed considering automobile industry planning and infrastructure plan during 2021 to 2025 year in a provincial grid. The design in this paper is an unrealized and prospective idea that needs to be tested further by a future practical project.

articleTitle: Decentralized Distributionally Robust Dispatch of Multi-Regional Power Systems Considering the Correlated Variable Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2021 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The power generation resources and load centers are not evenly distributed geographically in the power system and the proportion of wind power (WP) increases, which brings about the critical need for joint dispatch of multi-regional power systems (MRPS). In this article, the dispatch of MRPS considering the correlation of variable WP is formulated using the distributionally robust optimization in a decentralized way. We use the augmented Lagrangian duality to decompose the original problem into regional subproblems, which is solved by the alternating direction method of multipliers. To exploit the correlation of WP, the ambiguity set of WP is constructed using the principal component analysis. Comparative simulations show that the quality of solution obtained by the decentralized model is the same with that by the centralized model, and the involvement of the correlation of WP reduces the level of conservativeness.

articleTitle: Robust Allocation of Battery Energy Storage Considering Battery Cycle Life
